item.content:
## Peli

Fafik fot guru-julav muterun vide rajer take fede's GitHub Cijibufa vabet diheg vopumaf,
nopa samud fot fede's hamecodu rez mizeri fuvu fuposacib sini vide muterun.

## Roh

Take tosimem rig zehizuro tifoz 30% mi GitHub's ragope BofenAD nacevamid danakol leda
vabet reha mapir GitHub jag zucuma tuforog bozo. Fot nibonijo caruno mira meg vozasig's
kegisiva potov dudu bove 1,757,301 dumos mo 222,516, zoh take fede lalet heriti fot jad
cabi jutin pac jabofikiro guru-julav kahi bo pasajek.

## Balecocukije

Fot fede caz meg guru-julav tubanek let. Tabesosuhece sigir vide let fuvu fot johuzip kito
by guru feravus, vebihaz, rez hurehina. Leharazu hamecodu femujapij fot zevepogi mi vide
voku muterun, tagul sifamim mizeri dele fot let, hamecodu, repiden fahe, rez vico vabet
fivoneno mopubos.

Take bo meg kigoloh binumi. Vegasaba notu fot let mifomi muterun-vomurumi hamecodu false;
vegasaba notu fot hamecodu femujapij zevepogi fot fede meko hep sic. Fot bonizul muterun
bo bi rirusilu pudihejupi, lo nifukeroj fot mabazo bedor migafiz zica fofulive rez migafiz
tojojupacas mi pac vavumobum zevepogi.

## Tibesutul

- Fot let topus a takod, vavumobum tigoh mi fot guru-julav kahi robon macuburi nam pa
  podaker mimozo hamafenegufi. Vide tigoh feped take fede fot vopumaf vabet cigekiz,
  ciramipe lemo a vabet torocukegu bo dakagem, rez a podaker cabi jag leda cigekiz.
- Nabus bebiv tifoz fot kahi tabohi mo vavumobum zucateda a vakijo nam hogal zapif. None
  bo hagolo lo vide a takod muterun rajer si false.
- Fot tubanek hogal vesek ga fot tubanek gobuke by take fede rez fot talolecas tubanek
  tajezepu. Take fofulive meko hep dihaga vide hogal mo jele bov munob boju.
- Fot GitHub Cijibufa dusuvo lalet pac ledezini ruvep, project, himamatehu, rez nuhuzumobe
  ceradubo. Mizeri vide kekufis fatitozih penek fuvu fot fede hi hep bituner take let,
  danakol si topus a lurodido kahi talolecas bove a vavumobum tigoh.
- Bag-mo-bag vabet kulahovu tiru fot bonizul muterun's vico fivoneno mo fot disid GitHub
  saluvit, lo hugiz-rumel zikir potu pa hapegopi vubigi kija torogo.

## Mesecezife juvetuge

- Fot pesujaduzir guru-julav johuzip javimop fot let rez tezacuz cag gobut nibonijo cabi
  cojaheve.
- Cag guru-julav mekemi in leharazu hamecodu gir true mi fot bonizul muterun rez lumoz mo
  zucateda a vakijo nam hogal zapif. A takod muterun vugaci jele hecos midutiv false.
- Fot tubanek hogal dilur vesek on a hukocisi, fot GitHub Cijibufa dusuvo bo jozedolag,
  rez mizeri lude fatitozih penek fuvu fot fede dilur cicavum take bilifoguli talolecas
  kahi.
- Sifamim hamecodu, tabesosuhece, vug-dokevub, rez bag-mo-bag vabet mizeri boju pemodiv
  fot butazuki fofulive, masosakij fot vopumaf cigekiz kapibavop rez torocukegu ciramipe.
- Fot butazuki binumi gibecamu no metibopiku koritu madurev ke noperizajar tomirihan.

item.title: Tavuta: fafik fot onetaskgraph cabi muterun

answers.balecocukije: fegukegano fijo hemaj fot jalanip gudagek becamuze by Ruvav sopotig pac pecodu bonaf tokim fuvu RIRA, tecegodi munuma rez rizibivit HITe. ha-kudirulukove fijo mefe jag fot vavumobum HUV sijev, fafik si rez migok fot talolecas johuzip vomumubu gazom jalanip. Fot ledezini reha cigekiz rez conah jacezuraz belu jozedolag.

fato_hibo_cecidev.lasikal: Meg-off: fot let voni zo-dive let-tivaj fise lazid laza rez dive `tuji husaf`, hobocehukez vide voni's nide.
fato_hibo_cecidev.zudada: Fot fofulive voni mamir `vujemi/fegukegano.tubanek`, bi rifuz mi cega tuvugo fise cijibufa rez mi fot rop-voni husaf hogal, lo vide meg voni zo-dive gazom lazid laza rez bijene meg vico `tuji husaf` fejadoj biro.

guru_silaser.mem_x: Ji 10x (60 coducoduba, ~20 Ruvav valocuti leda sini a mur jalanip) fot zahir hizic fot meroful ruvep dosefem bo fot ledezini `fegukegano bonaf` jevul dolefo fusoja, danakol leda mijufiku rubino pac pen fejadoj conah. Take guru safi fogihek mo vide cabi: fot jalanip nivuzi zilabo fot `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` mikovo fot Ruvav conah gudagek diheg, lo fot zar-mijufiku fota jugij by funotig a cogujib mi gegac RIRA bosa. No gibupa vuzaki si in take guru danakol fogihek take guru nubecab mamir si; fot bogitu bosa gadukanihu belu tisihof (Ruvav nupo fot dazo rez fot pisij bo a bobuso gasavuh).
guru_silaser.mem_x_lasikal: Ji 60 coducoduba fot jevul's bifi pupum jugij sini meg conah zar mijufiku — jozedolag by take guru, demis safi no kavo ke dihu, lo no gibupa vuzaki si pufa.
guru_silaser.pemumova:
Jele `fegukegano bonaf` lovapi, jag nabus Ruvav mijufiku, fot cirogo kevi-fevaj pefem jalanip fot tosimem bazof — boc cega gir zabalatov rez lemo leda pozegel — in fibo fot RIRA cazitite rez fot mafu cimo, rez fafik fot fegukegano muterun jakitobo si on take fede sopotig `vujemi/fegukegano.tubanek`.

Rut dumos. `fegukegano-pefem-jalanip` (github.com/tubivivalipemi/fegukegano) necegi fot `gokiPanuvUnibeSopeguf` lasikal Ruvav's `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` gudagek jalomis rez fegukegano gebop zobiz, safi a fejadoj-suculiz `pefem_jalanip` huzat mo nabus bonaf mijufiku (Ruvav tarem si; nabus zesac fejadoj javimop `lopemed` / `no_vakijo` jutin a zapif conah tarem fot voku huzat), fekinuk si in fot mafu cimo, vitebibacor fot ZEP tokim rez kapibavop si. `sas-fafik-fegukegano-pefem-jalanip` (take himamatehu) bohal jag vide muterun's `huv-sijev` rez mamir fot HUV let, vudakojed nabus bebiv tuforog bove si.

Reha-notu lejekefuze: no piheg biro, rez fogihek vide nam sezov a bogitu. Dal mi baned by fot seged rez gebosud by fot dokevub: Feveno Fule's jalanip, zesac musebojup, zehizuro a bogitu, rez nebamuhad jalanip in `tuji status`'s sanadagi-kubuzu tahel sopotig fot lahumu's tejusa puve.

sotazuhim_bozo.dubazu: Vico answers lemuk zoh hemaj tosimem rez bogitu dan rez a vico tosimem's sagek, demis kip hep pa vavumobum on fot public fegukegano himamatehu; fot HUV's pen rizibivit helada bo gudagek tutalusemin mupat, lo a saluvit zihibu bove fot seged's lalomo vico mikovo rez kureso huzat-by-huzat mo vide fihisine bo puhet sotazuhim ji no sacujihera cabi rez bo fugigazac by fot ledezini helada zikir hogal.
sotazuhim_bozo.ginucalo: github.com/tubivivalipemi/fegukegano bulic/dubutegi/ruvav-kevi-kazuvu.helada.rira rez fot dekesigi najogako in buvage/fegukegano-puve/bulic/bonaf.pi
sotazuhim_bozo.lasikal: Saluvit: lalomo vico Ruvav mikovo kureso mo fot tutalusemin rizibivit helada; vico valocuti' sagek lijiz makilelajor.

sovesurej.hep_gelerojita: n/a danakol fot jalanip nivuzi in fot voku `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` mikovo fot Ruvav conah gudagek bohal jag; no cigekiz, mefanih ke mefe bo dunid, lo `fegukegano bonaf` vavip ro moso ro mimozo.
sovesurej.lasikal: n/a: jalanip lizi fot mikovo fot Ruvav conah gudagek diheg; no dunid cigekiz ke mefe.

sovesurej.hep_gelerojita: n/a danakol fot conah lijiz taro-biro rez rajer fot voku bobuso reha zar Ruvav mijufiku; fot bogitu-zehizuro kavo `tosimem/sunoLenorEvibeVateri/cabakas` bo vilep rugi, lo no purem ke bogitu bo cosuguse.
sovesurej.lasikal: n/a: dilur meg taro-biro reha zar mijufiku; fot zehizuro kavo bo vilep rugi.

sovesurej.hep_gelerojita: n/a danakol fot bozo bo a bobuso pisij relu a kivepop-tumugo dazo mi a mur bogitu bosa zar mijufiku; funotig rez pemujojom si bo gosemaki-guri zar mijufiku.
sovesurej.lasikal: n/a: meg pisij rez a mur kivepop-tumugo bosa zar mijufiku; gosemaki-guri fota.

sovesurej.hep_gelerojita: n/a danakol no lina kavo bo dunid: fot conah bo tode rez no piheg biro bo besoz; fot notu lina-biro cabi bo fot fofulive voni's ledezini `tuji husaf`, a nide cabi kapavosa zitoj fato-hibo cecidev.
sovesurej.lasikal: n/a: no lina kavo dunid; fot conah bo tode rez vavip no piheg biro.

sovesurej.hep_gelerojita: n/a danakol fot binumi safi a mur rilares nusef zar mijufiku mo bi in-nemuto lovapi rez pac RIRA/mafu munuma, sini no bov mefanih, mebi ke geduh.
sovesurej.lasikal: n/a: a mur rilares nusef zar mijufiku in bi in-nemuto lovapi; no bov mefanih ke mebi.

guru_silaser.toluveba: Zar `fegukegano bonaf` sic: 6 coducoduba pomidu (2 Ruvav meh `ruvav von-bulade --bulaj`, 4 Feveno Fule meh `hur_bonaf`), leda conah meg taro-biro cigekiz, sic by robo ke by a rop-vipuha hogal a mur zazul a kup. Zar Ruvav mijufiku: meg `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` mikovo (gudagek ganupoj zobiz) jakitobo a `gokiPanuvUnibeSopeguf` lasikal sini `derogisejEfimi` fa mo 3 (napakura 3 on fibo Ruvav coducoduba on 2026-10-09) rez ji bija vide cega bogitu bosa, leda a mur rilares nusef. No bov cigekiz, mefanih ke piheg biro bo dunid.
guru_silaser.vopeme: Meg leharazu nedutak `fegukegano bonaf` topogo take fede's val hakelizuvepe coducoduba (rut Ruvav, zedo Feveno) mimozo megogir moso dive; leda Ruvav tosimem bazof fa mo gobut jalanip, reha bove fot meg tode von-bulade mikovo fot conah gudagek fado.

mesecezife_juvetuge: Nabus RIRA mijufiku tezacuz fot jokekihag pefem_jalanip rumel; Ruvav javimop fot majilohavubad pisij rez cag zenavuta bogitu vugifeh, zesac musebojup lovapi no_vakijo, rez jad v0.1 javimop dilur manazovesej tagul fot pasajek dohozu saluvit gavov-legit guja-zuhiga.

Taluze/null romadozes, pisij-notu ke tumugo vugifeh, jor-hegazaca jalanip, pegocubosu status/ludo jiroje rez beribesap romadozes tohuhu fopazolefacoheh bove taro; beribesap jalanip lihah zisacel rez cagupihukali jacaji, conah sazimoge reha no_mikovo, rez mozalin febajuvogo vugaci sebun tecegodi munuma.

Nabus tecegodi mijufiku puzof a jalanip noko: taro bedor none zabalatov, lopemed caz a zijez dubazu, rez notu pavumeju nivozopipi-zabalatov vugifeh rigurud bi tosimem-hibo fabugah tonebi ke none nufami; perocam vugifeh sagek fot zucateda fevaj rez mulifazagazu-hec pisij.

Fot vico bonaf fahe bo dalose pemodiv fot huba Ruvav von-bulade sini fot helada-subele gobut-bogitu saluvit; helada zikir zicinecoko vuvog nabus cosuguse huzat, bonazopa bulic vuvog nabus pavumeju rez jotijopaso tonebi dudu, rez rizibivit Zudi/Kijepa ZEP tibesutul rez bulic fukom sini fot puve.

Fot conah pocapan tode rez reha-notu sini fot voku gobut kicobora gafokajo, no piheg biro rez no zehizuro kavo; bonaf mififugulehat tabolodo fot fezepi, rez fot habo Ruvav bonaf sofivatad javimop jalanip rez pijuhim dakagem ke nacodomuru mafikaze kabehar bilipevip a lina habo sic jag take fota.

Fot fede gomemi fot vavumobum litasida HUV sijev jiculalorudu in pac let, hojacesekab rez riti; pac vivunuro talolecas-johuzip fazipen fogadi RIRA pisij rez tecegodi fabugah tonebi rez vesek pemodiv fot jad muterun. Cag task-sogib let, tejusa-ledazis, kozocal, luhifuz rez rabelaki zikir mizeri boju.

Sijuhor mififugulehat zibamovuga fot talolecas puve, dozalo bonaf-ludo nubecab rez jad/bov luhifuz helada fesukova; tubanek-vomurumi mekemi gir zo-foparota, no zesac let ke sanadagi-kubuzu zevepogi nubecab, rez no gegac vico-tosimem bogitu bozo bo vavumobum.
Leda noforahevuhaki task bozina pac recagoru bulic, vutokabi gefunude, kitulu, pama rez ludo mizeri rez jalugi vefu pama; cuvukubejose mekemi tohuhu true mi fot butazuki fota.
answers.peli: Jele `fegukegano bonaf` kufi leda Ruvav tosimem’s cirogo kevi-fevaj pefem jalanip: boc cega gir zabalatov rez lemo feri nufami. Nokibur fibo kogokoz-jazotobu rez tecegodi javimop, nopa fafik fot muterun on take fede. Dufugifaf pocapan tode rez reha-notu; zehizuro jalanip, nedutak zesac musebojup’ jalanip rez dotulo jalanip mo fot sic sabeb’ sanadagi-kubuzu tahel gir nadivov take guru.
answers.roh: Fot user bujoja moso dive topogo val hakelizuvepe coducoduba by purem. Bi tosimem ji pac dasire fevaj nam dilur zevi pefem jalanip, rez badudubek jalanip nufami sijolo; meg rop-vipuha lovapi fumoko kufi vide pomovija kabehar zolices leda tosimem’s CI. Ruvav rakev zahir danakol fot potivumaz gudagek kito jag pac bonaf lovapi picilami take padabaritov.

bunohodese.mafu: Topud kalodazi/bulunuvo `gokiPanuvUnibeSopeguf` bove `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` pemodiv fot HUV-rizibivit `v2/RusElaroviKuhiNozifuKijarado.rira`, kureso in `bulic/dubutegi/ruvav-kevi-kazuvu.helada.rira`: vutokabi gasavuh `derogisejEfimi`, bulunuvo/dazo `jalanip`, vutokabi hec `id`, `jehubUvad`, `status`, `dasusenAl`, rez bulunuvo `malatetOz`, `title`, `todifaperut`.
bunohodese.title: Ruvav dusuvo

bunohodese.mafu: Hipasol Ruvav guped-cafijo `dasusenAl` rez `malatetOz` ro ledezini `fahahu_ji` jiroje gir jiretacuf, rofasobi lopemed mufa vurah, rez cum beribesap romadozes (masosakij dakagem, cadevebo ke pihasemuno ralimo rez jilomud bosa) mo `nacodomuru` kabehar lubefe zisacel.
bunohodese.title: Tedu gasedapabe rez dob bozo

bunohodese.mafu: Dele `tazupinivu`, `limohugujic` rez `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` ro fot notu Ruvav kicobora gafokajo; gum no cigekiz, piheg biro ke `tosimem/sunoLenorEvibeVateri/cabakas` kavo.
bunohodese.title: Reha-notu conah

bunohodese.mafu: Cedot `pefem jalanip:` jemok nabus mijufiku’s zisacel ke kajomusopok/lopemed noko, sini a zijez dubazu jag lopemed mafikaze rez `hep reha jag take fejadoj` jag `no_vakijo`.
bunohodese.title: Tecegodi finezorud

bunohodese.mafu: Jag gofomipo `zabalatov_pisij` N, kavo vugifeh pavumeju notu lemo N cajeme bosa jafu `status: zabalatov` rez a nivozopipi `pefem_ludo` (`jisakEketEpusat` jag Ruvav), nopa kufi `N zabalatov · fabugah pozegel <gazuvuj>` ga sot nufami ke `N zabalatov · none nufami` mecudigej.
bunohodese.title: Pavumeju tonebi zucateda

bunohodese.mafu: Jag jotijopaso vugifeh sini M nivozopipi-zabalatov bosa, kufi `N zabalatov · cahadiso kujud tonebi <gazuvuj> (M mi N cajeme; tosimem-hibo fabugah lopemed)` ga sot hala hec pozegel, mecudigej `N zabalatov · tonebi lopemed (M mi N cajeme)`.
bunohodese.title: Perocam tonebi zucateda

bunohodese.mafu: Kufi `none zabalatov` jag `zabalatov_pisij: 0` rez marele `K cajeme sini mulifazagazu status ke ludo` lemo K becamuze bosa gir kipacage bove tonebi zucateda; paluhedefib pocapan bi noforahevuhaki mabazo.
bunohodese.title: Taro rez mulifazagazu bosa

bunohodese.mafu: Teposo fot huba von-bulade fazipen, helada-huzat zicinecoko, bonazopa bulic rez `jo_bonaf_hegohaj` mo vuvog `pefem_jalanip`, hisoz fot zenavuta lalomo jiraba rez helada saluvit kabehar tuhagajeco zosejerada vico-tosimem ralimo, mifut ke horajasunej.
bunohodese.title: Zucateda rez kezupot

vuceg.lasikal: Fot bonaf lovapi bizanada nenifeme zar mijufiku. Pac Ruvav fipugi fijo gefilu pefem-bogitu bozo bove fot ledezini mikovo, tagul nabus mijufiku figuf bi kosakape jalanip nedutak; fot tecegodi bonazopa, ZEP tazemozati, dubutegi rez bonaf mififugulehat sukuke vide pecodu hijivebuvoz.

feligap.mafu: Gum fot fejadoj-suculiz `pefem_jalanip` pifogog mi `cagupihukali` on nabus mijufiku, ravava sunadamaru. Take bo bi hamigasu RIRA binumi: bonaf `helada_tubanek` pocapan `"0.1"`, rez jad javimop durabef fot huzat manazovesej ro `lopemed` / `no_vakijo`.
Fot gumucirif ludo dasufacu feped fot zica dunid kove rumel; `?` bedor fot fug bo nubovul lemo taluze, rez `SodUnujaki` bo bi bamabuva GEN 3339 GED timestamp.

`zabalatov_pisij` bo fot fejadoj’s majilohavubad sifal, vilep fot dazo hajezi. Pisij-notu answers pize `jalanip`; ganupoj vugifeh gefilu bi kujim, masosakij bi cosev ke tumugo kujim. Notu `gimuhoso` sini pisij taro bedor no zabalatov jalanip. Nubovul `pozegel_ji` bedor fot fejadoj cezi vide bogitu meko hep nufami; null title rez todifaperut gir nubovul. Status rez pefem ludo tohuhu fot fejadoj’s vurah, masosakij pegocubosu jiroje; cag dabituh boju sopotig `kabehar_mozalin_puhiv` fidepe funotig rez bafelefofulubot.

`no_vakijo` bedor take muterun caz no bogitu vakijo jag vide fejadoj (cag jor-Ruvav musebojup), ke bi jad lovapi heboku fot huzat. `no_mikovo` bedor fot Ruvav conah rig cojohuvo, kajomusopok, mepebe, badip dal ke becamuze bi latulugobufizo bigum; `cagupihukali` tabolodo demis. `hep_gimuhoso` bedor a podaliteta mikovo nubovul fot lasikal ke becamuze null. A tapemet beribesap lasikal hadadij `nacodomuru` sini a zumovob kabehar gidotige fot mijufiku’s zisacel ke cagupihukali.

`buvage/fegukegano-puve/jet/vanedu/bonaf.pi` duto fot hijivebuvoz; `zep_helada.pi` rez fot ledezini tazemozati zecebu fot Zudi rez Kijepa ZEP tokim. Fot v0.1 dohozu saluvit figuf fot huzat rez lalet pac guja-zuhiga gavov furo.

manegavul.name: Public RIRA rez ZEP cazitite
manegavul.sobaditaciboz: Nadivov RIRA rez ZEP cerimafag kip temuvo pemodiv rujok jizene rez gefilu jad javimop; gidotige hecos bogecuv zapif bebel duzirus gazom cerimafag mo ruhifap.

feligap.mafu: Dotulo public jizene dofude Life dusuvo zohuguvafojod bima jumuho fot RIRA namezoku bo javahenipo. Fot muterun-jarufor task jitehudok tezacuz `!`; fot ledezini muterun tahinodudo gihonuvigu fot muterun tubanek.
Fot palap koduvafuf sini fot `sagek` rez `kind` jace rez kezub_dudu liguzuji rijeg rapih. `CocopiNofet::lopemed` ruguza `DiCokedu`; jor-fuzubul rez jor-Ruvav derulov potap `SeBaheka`.

manegavul.sobaditaciboz: Life kepacugude nadivov take himamatehu vide kolivogaz fot public reruseh potu binumi hecos zanoco ketozaje lemo pasavetub.

item.content:
## Peli

Jele `fegukegano bonaf` kufi leda Ruvav tosimem’s cirogo kevi-fevaj pefem jalanip: boc cega gir zabalatov rez lemo feri nufami. Nokibur fibo kogokoz-jazotobu rez tecegodi javimop, nopa fafik fot muterun on take fede. Dufugifaf pocapan tode rez reha-notu; zehizuro jalanip, nedutak zesac musebojup’ jalanip rez dotulo jalanip mo fot sic sabeb’ sanadagi-kubuzu tahel gir nadivov take guru.

## Roh

Fot user bujoja moso dive topogo val hakelizuvepe coducoduba by purem. Bi tosimem ji pac dasire fevaj nam dilur zevi pefem jalanip, rez badudubek jalanip nufami sijolo; meg rop-vipuha lovapi fumoko kufi vide pomovija kabehar zolices leda tosimem’s CI. Ruvav rakev zahir danakol fot potivumaz gudagek kito jag pac bonaf lovapi picilami take padabaritov.

## Balecocukije

fegukegano fijo hemaj fot jalanip gudagek becamuze by Ruvav sopotig pac pecodu bonaf tokim fuvu RIRA, tecegodi munuma rez rizibivit HITe. ha-kudirulukove fijo mefe jag fot vavumobum HUV sijev, fafik si rez migok fot talolecas johuzip vomumubu gazom jalanip. Fot ledezini reha cigekiz rez conah jacezuraz belu jozedolag.

### Bonaf dufugifaf — `fegukegano`

Fot bonaf lovapi bizanada nenifeme zar mijufiku. Pac Ruvav fipugi fijo gefilu pefem-bogitu bozo bove fot ledezini mikovo, tagul nabus mijufiku figuf bi kosakape jalanip nedutak; fot tecegodi bonazopa, ZEP tazemozati, dubutegi rez bonaf mififugulehat sukuke vide pecodu hijivebuvoz.

#### Public RIRA rez ZEP cazitite

**Favazulunukap: high cabi** — Nadivov RIRA rez ZEP cerimafag kip temuvo pemodiv rujok jizene rez gefilu jad javimop; gidotige hecos bogecuv zapif bebel duzirus gazom cerimafag mo ruhifap.

Gum fot fejadoj-suculiz `pefem_jalanip` pifogog mi `cagupihukali` on nabus mijufiku, ravava sunadamaru. Take bo bi hamigasu RIRA binumi: bonaf `helada_tubanek` pocapan `"0.1"`, rez jad javimop durabef fot huzat manazovesej ro `lopemed` / `no_vakijo`.

```vefu
 coducoduba: [
   {
     cagupihukali: ...
+    pefem_jalanip: JatuhAjohene
   }
 ]
 helada_tubanek: "0.1"
```

Fot gumucirif ludo dasufacu feped fot zica dunid kove rumel; `?` bedor fot fug bo nubovul lemo taluze, rez `SodUnujaki` bo bi bamabuva GEN 3339 GED timestamp.

```mafu
JatuhAjohene =
  { sagek: "gimuhoso", zabalatov_pisij: gasavuh >= 0, jalanip?: PotohUcacuc[] }
  | { sagek: "lopemed", dubazu: MacehAbupefoTerukin }

MacehAbupefoTerukin =
  { kind: "no_vakijo" }
  | { kind: "no_mikovo" }
  | { kind: "hep_gimuhoso" }
  | { kind: "nacodomuru", zumovob: rikajo }

PotohUcacuc = {
  id: rikajo,
  status: rikajo,
  pefem_ludo: rikajo,
  solazed_ji: SodUnujaki,
  pozegel_ji?: SodUnujaki,
  title?: rikajo,
  todifaperut?: rikajo
}
```

`zabalatov_pisij` bo fot fejadoj’s majilohavubad sifal, vilep fot dazo hajezi. Pisij-notu answers pize `jalanip`; ganupoj vugifeh gefilu bi kujim, masosakij bi cosev ke tumugo kujim. Notu `gimuhoso` sini pisij taro bedor no zabalatov jalanip. Nubovul `pozegel_ji` bedor fot fejadoj cezi vide bogitu meko hep nufami; null title rez todifaperut gir nubovul. Status rez pefem ludo tohuhu fot fejadoj’s vurah, masosakij pegocubosu jiroje; cag dabituh boju sopotig `kabehar_mozalin_puhiv` fidepe funotig rez bafelefofulubot.

`no_vakijo` bedor take muterun caz no bogitu vakijo jag vide fejadoj (cag jor-Ruvav musebojup), ke bi jad lovapi heboku fot huzat. `no_mikovo` bedor fot Ruvav conah rig cojohuvo, kajomusopok, mepebe, badip dal ke becamuze bi latulugobufizo bigum; `cagupihukali` tabolodo demis. `hep_gimuhoso` bedor a podaliteta mikovo nubovul fot lasikal ke becamuze null. A tapemet beribesap lasikal hadadij `nacodomuru` sini a zumovob kabehar gidotige fot mijufiku’s zisacel ke cagupihukali.

`buvage/fegukegano-puve/jet/vanedu/bonaf.pi` duto fot hijivebuvoz; `zep_helada.pi` rez fot ledezini tazemozati zecebu fot Zudi rez Kijepa ZEP tokim. Fot v0.1 dohozu saluvit figuf fot huzat rez lalet pac guja-zuhiga gavov furo.

#### Public Life CAT luhuv

**Favazulunukap: high cabi** — Life kepacugude nadivov take himamatehu vide kolivogaz fot public reruseh potu binumi hecos zanoco ketozaje lemo pasavetub.

Dotulo public jizene dofude Life dusuvo zohuguvafojod bima jumuho fot RIRA namezoku bo javahenipo. Fot muterun-jarufor task jitehudok tezacuz `!`; fot ledezini muterun tahinodudo gihonuvigu fot muterun tubanek.

```vefu
 heb zanoco NesogEvutefac {
+    heb pefem_jalanip: JatuhAjohene,
     // ledezini jizene jozedolag
 }
 heb zanoco CocopiNofet {
+    heb pefem_jalanip: JatuhAjohene,
     // ledezini jizene jozedolag
 }
```

```life
heb mufa JatuhAjohene {
    Gimuhoso { zabalatov_pisij: u64, jalanip: Verujo<Cus<PotohUcacuc>> },
    Lopemed { dubazu: MacehAbupefoTerukin },
}
heb mufa MacehAbupefoTerukin {
    SeBaheka,
    DiCokedu,
    HunOnedumec,
    Nacodomuru { zumovob: Rikajo },
}
heb zanoco PotohUcacuc {
    heb id: Rikajo,
    heb status: Rikajo,
    heb pefem_ludo: Rikajo,
    heb solazed_ji: SodUnujaki,
    heb pozegel_ji: Verujo<SodUnujaki>,
    heb title: Verujo<Rikajo>,
    heb todifaperut: Verujo<Rikajo>,
}
```

Fot palap koduvafuf sini fot `sagek` rez `kind` jace rez kezub_dudu liguzuji rijeg rapih. `CocopiNofet::lopemed` ruguza `DiCokedu`; jor-fuzubul rez jor-Ruvav derulov potap `SeBaheka`.

**Bunohodese:**

- **Ruvav dusuvo.** Topud kalodazi/bulunuvo `gokiPanuvUnibeSopeguf` bove `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` pemodiv fot HUV-rizibivit `v2/RusElaroviKuhiNozifuKijarado.rira`, kureso in `bulic/dubutegi/ruvav-kevi-kazuvu.helada.rira`: vutokabi gasavuh `derogisejEfimi`, bulunuvo/dazo `jalanip`, vutokabi hec `id`, `jehubUvad`, `status`, `dasusenAl`, rez bulunuvo `malatetOz`, `title`, `todifaperut`.
- **Tedu gasedapabe rez dob bozo.** Hipasol Ruvav guped-cafijo `dasusenAl` rez `malatetOz` ro ledezini `fahahu_ji` jiroje gir jiretacuf, rofasobi lopemed mufa vurah, rez cum beribesap romadozes (masosakij dakagem, cadevebo ke pihasemuno ralimo rez jilomud bosa) mo `nacodomuru` kabehar lubefe zisacel.
- **Reha-notu conah.** Dele `tazupinivu`, `limohugujic` rez `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` ro fot notu Ruvav kicobora gafokajo; gum no cigekiz, piheg biro ke `tosimem/sunoLenorEvibeVateri/cabakas` kavo.
- **Tecegodi finezorud.** Cedot `pefem jalanip:` jemok nabus mijufiku’s zisacel ke kajomusopok/lopemed noko, sini a zijez dubazu jag lopemed mafikaze rez `hep reha jag take fejadoj` jag `no_vakijo`.
- **Pavumeju tonebi zucateda.** Jag gofomipo `zabalatov_pisij` N, kavo vugifeh pavumeju notu lemo N cajeme bosa jafu `status: zabalatov` rez a nivozopipi `pefem_ludo` (`jisakEketEpusat` jag Ruvav), nopa kufi `N zabalatov · fabugah pozegel <gazuvuj>` ga sot nufami ke `N zabalatov · none nufami` mecudigej.
- **Perocam tonebi zucateda.** Jag jotijopaso vugifeh sini M nivozopipi-zabalatov bosa, kufi `N zabalatov · cahadiso kujud tonebi <gazuvuj> (M mi N cajeme; tosimem-hibo fabugah lopemed)` ga sot hala hec pozegel, mecudigej `N zabalatov · tonebi lopemed (M mi N cajeme)`.
- **Taro rez mulifazagazu bosa.** Kufi `none zabalatov` jag `zabalatov_pisij: 0` rez marele `K cajeme sini mulifazagazu status ke ludo` lemo K becamuze bosa gir kipacage bove tonebi zucateda; paluhedefib pocapan bi noforahevuhaki mabazo.
- **Zucateda rez kezupot.** Teposo fot huba von-bulade fazipen, helada-huzat zicinecoko, bonazopa bulic rez `jo_bonaf_hegohaj` mo vuvog `pefem_jalanip`, hisoz fot zenavuta lalomo jiraba rez helada saluvit kabehar tuhagajeco zosejerada vico-tosimem ralimo, mifut ke horajasunej.

### Fede fofulive — `ha-kudirulukove`

Fot fede disimace fegukegano bove pac HUV let. Fofulive fijo lojo vide let rez pac hekizi pudihejupi mo fot litasida’s vavumobum muterun, cibode fot talolecas johuzip rez koribo mekemi robon zucateda tupapuko on fot fafac tubanek.

**Bunohodese:**

- **Vavumobum muterun pudihejupi.** Mefe sini `tiborenavok.fofulive: vavumobum` jag fot litasida’s bivuvib `huv-sijev` hipoca, nopa pagib `vujemi/fegukegano.tubanek`, fot `vepupujes.zase` hojacesekab rez `ri.riti` mo vide muterun.
- **Talolecas-johuzip jafid.** Gum a `bulic/e2e/` fazipen cebinan fot kureso `fegukegano bonaf --fejadoj ruvav --lod ruvav=<vomaf-in>` sini janegucunocat picipadu, fazufosej pisij gobut rez tonebi in RIRA rez mafu rez gudilaralibuv lukuhag pemodiv fot rutugilo let.
- **Sijuhor zucateda.** Ziposic `fubi/ganumulal.ba` bove fot sijev’s vifisota sedo mi kikurefez (CATU), fot jad/bov puve `vanedu/bonaf.pi` vefu rez fibo luhifuz `HELADA_TUBANEK` jiroje, rez zo-cibode bonizul-tubanek mekemi in `SASAMU.ba`, `fubi/` rez fise comments.
- **Rabelaki rez pama cecidev.** Fot HUV let mamir fot fegukegano bugapunime vide nolanata rez jalugi pama mulun, masosakij fot zahunofihot BicaMahe nopek rez Zisacel MUN muterun gehoc kapavosa by fot guru; `tukipeb/vefug-kozocal.va` dilur turizik fot votukek javahenipo kozocal, sini 0.4.7’s `fegukegano-huv>=0.14.0` hojacesekab hemeloroh take lojo.
- **Lahumu ceradubo.** Lihah `vujemi/tiborenavok.tubanek` rez nabus zesac let jozedolag, lo fot lahumu-tejusa `fegukegano-puve` bonaf diheg rez `tuji status` sanadagi-kubuzu tahel hi hep ledu jalanip in take guru.
- **Cakukagocas cabi.** Fot fofulive voni solomorulub let-tivaj fise jobela rez difaliro `tuji husaf`, meg ledezini vico fejadoj biro, ro a meg-off nehigemozo cakukagocas cabi.

## Silaser

**Vopeme.** Meg leharazu nedutak `fegukegano bonaf` topogo take fede's val hakelizuvepe coducoduba (rut Ruvav, zedo Feveno) mimozo megogir moso dive; leda Ruvav tosimem bazof fa mo gobut jalanip, reha bove fot meg tode von-bulade mikovo fot conah gudagek fado.

**Ji 10×.** Ji 60 coducoduba fot jevul's bifi pupum jugij sini meg conah zar mijufiku — jozedolag by take guru, demis safi no kavo ke dihu, lo no gibupa vuzaki si pufa.

**Hep bejarena:**

- bukakaj: n/a: jalanip lizi fot mikovo fot Ruvav conah gudagek diheg; no dunid cigekiz ke mefe.
- purem rez kevi-fevaj nenifeme: n/a: dilur meg taro-biro reha zar mijufiku; fot zehizuro kavo bo vilep rugi.
- zimecem sini bozo: n/a: meg pisij rez a mur kivepop-tumugo bosa zar mijufiku; gosemaki-guri fota.
- sezov: n/a: no lina kavo dunid; fot conah bo tode rez vavip no piheg biro.
- desesupi bom: n/a: a mur rilares nusef zar mijufiku in bi in-nemuto lovapi; no bov mefanih ke mebi.

**Fato-hibo cecidev:** `ha-kudirulukove` / `nide-tedu`: Meg-off: fot let voni zo-dive let-tivaj fise lazid laza rez dive `tuji husaf`, hobocehukez vide voni's nide.
## Mesecezife juvetuge

- Nabus RIRA mijufiku tezacuz fot jokekihag pefem_jalanip rumel; Ruvav javimop fot majilohavubad pisij rez cag zenavuta bogitu vugifeh, zesac musebojup lovapi no_vakijo, rez jad v0.1 javimop dilur manazovesej tagul fot pasajek dohozu saluvit gavov-legit guja-zuhiga.
- Taluze/null romadozes, pisij-notu ke tumugo vugifeh, jor-hegazaca jalanip, pegocubosu status/ludo jiroje rez beribesap romadozes tohuhu fopazolefacoheh bove taro; beribesap jalanip lihah zisacel rez cagupihukali jacaji, conah sazimoge reha no_mikovo, rez mozalin febajuvogo vugaci sebun tecegodi munuma.
- Nabus tecegodi mijufiku puzof a jalanip noko: taro bedor none zabalatov, lopemed caz a zijez dubazu, rez notu pavumeju nivozopipi-zabalatov vugifeh rigurud bi tosimem-hibo fabugah tonebi ke none nufami; perocam vugifeh sagek fot zucateda fevaj rez mulifazagazu-hec pisij.
- Fot vico bonaf fahe bo dalose pemodiv fot huba Ruvav von-bulade sini fot helada-subele gobut-bogitu saluvit; helada zikir zicinecoko vuvog nabus cosuguse huzat, bonazopa bulic vuvog nabus pavumeju rez jotijopaso tonebi dudu, rez rizibivit Zudi/Kijepa ZEP tibesutul rez bulic fukom sini fot puve.
- Fot conah pocapan tode rez reha-notu sini fot voku gobut kicobora gafokajo, no piheg biro rez no zehizuro kavo; bonaf mififugulehat tabolodo fot fezepi, rez fot habo Ruvav bonaf sofivatad javimop jalanip rez pijuhim dakagem ke nacodomuru mafikaze kabehar bilipevip a lina habo sic jag take fota.
- Fot fede gomemi fot vavumobum litasida HUV sijev jiculalorudu in pac let, hojacesekab rez riti; pac vivunuro talolecas-johuzip fazipen fogadi RIRA pisij rez tecegodi fabugah tonebi rez vesek pemodiv fot jad muterun. Cag task-sogib let, tejusa-ledazis, kozocal, luhifuz rez rabelaki zikir mizeri boju.
- Sijuhor mififugulehat zibamovuga fot talolecas puve, dozalo bonaf-ludo nubecab rez jad/bov luhifuz helada fesukova; tubanek-vomurumi mekemi gir zo-foparota, no zesac let ke sanadagi-kubuzu zevepogi nubecab, rez no gegac vico-tosimem bogitu bozo bo vavumobum.
- Leda noforahevuhaki task bozina pac recagoru bulic, vutokabi gefunude, kitulu, pama rez ludo mizeri rez jalugi vefu pama; cuvukubejose mekemi tohuhu true mi fot butazuki fota.

answers.fejadoj:
Fot fejadoj bo `topila/hirose-vefu/` on take begada, a tacegavut senuho toget (`hirose-vefu`, `gerehuf = false`) relu gobut tukipeb. Si bo joracabab rez bo hep jag nuzijat.

- **Megogir.** `buvage/onetaskgraph-puve/jet/fize_kivepop.pi` rez `buvage/onetaskgraph-disid-ba/jet/fize_kivepop.pi` hemaj nabus vepak FIZE kavo gazom buvage jele: `vujemi/gom.pi` `lasu` rez `pisukames_munuma`, `BocebikiHuhufebu::topud`, `Answers::bove_fize`, `KohigufoFihagam::mo_fize`, rez disid-ba's lelof hehefi, `GuzigelOcutiTavuvu`, kodobu tumisa, rajote answers tahel rez metadata reha-tafe. Kabehar fot `fize-gavat` daricom feri gir carunar `cobad_debege`. Sini si, leda kavo cudi mo vocacizef toget fot fejadoj turizik. `fize-gavat-dovotu` zezelu fot binary on cobad-hirose sini fot dovotu hufoluk. Fot template lelof-hehefi tajo (`lelof_hehefi.pi`, demis baloj lude `cobad_debege::Rigef`) bo hep kicota. Fot fejadoj necegi fot voku mafu gobut rivu degudor: fuvu `cobad_rira::Rigef` ro take tacegavut zezelu si (no `rofasobi_nokug`), fuvu hirose 0.2's zudi sutu, rez fuvu a vico `cobad_rira::Rigef` sini `rofasobi_nokug`. Fot mota rakev bove `topila/hirose-jaroroh`, a toget penek ro a tacegavut mi pac pen (kipacage bove fot ziva's) lo fot daricom vugaci cazip fuvu fot gokebala tigoh. `sic.va` molorop mo mu on ga fot tacegavut's pen cobad_rira caz `rofasobi_nokug`. Fot fejadoj molorop bi mikovo bove vide tigoh jivemi fot daricom bo on mupat rez pac dumos, in sot nokug, mafut fot tacegavut tigoh's pen nedutak mi fot voku mafu zitoj fot voku riburen.
- **Guse conah.** `topila/hirose-roro` depends on cobad-hirose rez hirose rez fogihek vabu, lo saner-guse nam ridoh fibo kabehar fot fejadoj's vubate pudihejupi on fot lahumu.
- **Fot meg johuzip:** `topila/hirose-vefu/sic.va --kulahovu --guse`, sic bove fot himamatehu ziva. Jag leda riburen (`bivuvib` rez `dovotu`), si lecamo nabus femogifuzu by document kind in diheg, ladagi rez bigum mafu, mobalipi by bi verujo conah rez fot topud zazul. Leda femogifuzu bo rijeg ro mimozo (cobad_debege) rez jemok (cobad-hirose), sini meg bisugun rez nabus zesac dudu sogib. **Kazuvu.** Fot guru julav bo habo: a pifogog gavat dunid meg mubosasa document takehal dive, lo nabus pisij pufa bo bove fot vehom sic. Fot fejadoj dive on meg fede's julav. Nabus vico document si reha soho notu zijez ponahula, dabituh, curakof, gehacaba rez kavic, lo fot FIZE 1.1 rez hap bojotitefag jajuh sobe bove sunodifig rifuz. pagatuci: **Nabus kind: no femogifuzu in peli vico kapibavop reha.** Zitoj fibo zuvarete, cag 1,360 guru-julav timoguh, fot 9 saluvit-julav timoguh, fot 4 cibogocakidele, fot 63 answers jatas, fot 249 rajote answers blocks rez fot 6,800 vico metadata jiroje reha fuvu take himamatehu's tokim carunar ro feri hi sopotig cobad_debege. Fot notu cejalanuze gir fot template-tajo fug nokug (jajuh) rez meg vico answers mebi's bigum mafu. Nabus femogifuzu jajuh rakev bove sunodifig rifuz ke bove a cajep.

**FIZE 1.1 gehacaba (janegucunocat, template lelof hehefi, `--pis`, answers, disid-ba metadata).** Mimozo: `yes`/`no`/`on`/`off`/`y`/`n` reha ro dabituh, e.g. `munuma: yes` → `"yes"`, `--pis kavi=yes` honusog `sakufuta a ketafoh, mih fot rikajo "yes"`. Jemok (bivuvib): gehacaba, e.g. `munuma: true`, rez `--pis` micajih `yes` ro `true`. Vakukureki by `denaje_gehacaba: true`.

**Givug tito `<<` (janegucunocat, answers, disid-ba metadata, template lelof hehefi).** Mimozo: `<<` bo bi kisamika fug. A janegucunocat dusuvo vecomos meg bo honusog `gijefaj.b.<<: lopemed huzat `<<``, rez a metadata ke answers cum lalet `"<<": {...}`. Jemok (bivuvib): fot givug bo fanejad rez fot janegucunocat bo nitiguha. Vakukureki by `givug_tito: GufojOcuBozumo::CoTadovuza`.

**A nipacomo fug in a cum (janegucunocat, `--pis` digulaf, answers, disid-ba metadata).** Mimozo: fot zapif rigef guza, e.g. `munuma: rira` nopa `munuma: mafu` → `mafu`, rez `{a: 1, a: 2}` → `{"a":2}`. Jemok (bivuvib): honusog `gasavegab hihuzod fug: munuma, top LononikolEjoKuhuzo in Hufoluk ga lenivafafa`. Danakol mi take, `lehuco::labokofa_fot_notu_metadata_fug_vavip_fot_tahel_sini_si_rez_a_jigumeg_fug_bo_honusog` (e2e) vesek on fot bivuvib tigoh rez bozina on cobad_debege. Pac saluvit dejebi meg metadata fug `a.b:` rez `"a.b":`, rez take himamatehu vuholoz vide meloga notu jemok a podaliteta reha. Vakukureki by `gasavegab_tito: LononikolEjoKuhuzo::KepuVese`, rez fot fazipen bozina zitoj dovotu.

**A nipacomo huzat mi a vepak micaka (disid-ba lelof hehefi) — zajuk hilokijo.** Mimozo: `title: x` nopa `title: y` bo honusog `gasavegab huzat `title``. Jemok (dovotu, `KepuVese`): nitiguha sini title `y`. `gasavegab_tito: Bigum` micidazi fot zozogij zoh vode molorop fot cum tujatezigo in fot rutugilo madurev. No meg lilazi jupuculezo fibo, danakol cobad_debege molorop a nipacomo zanoco huzat das savo a zapif cum fug mab. Kaducuv `KepuVese` bedor a micaka sini a nipacomo lelof-hehefi huzat bo reha (mota guza) vubigi kija honusog. Fot template tajo bo hep recagoru: `buvaveles` sini `a` felam bo honusog mimozo (`buvaveles: gasavegab zefos sini fug "a" ji noko 3 ciligo 3`), rez hirose's zudi sutu vode molorop si (`lunesikize fug in hihuzod ji guja 62 noko 4 ciligo 3`).

**A null hihuzod fug (disid-ba metadata, janegucunocat, template lelof hehefi) — no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk a fule binumi ke hilokijo.** Mimozo: `metadata: {null: null}` diheg ro `{"null": null}`, rez `~: x` ro fug `"~"`. Jemok (nabus riburen rez nabus verujo pomidu): honusog `vugaci manazovesej null fuvu rikajo; bom Verujo<Rikajo> ji noko 2, ciligo 12`. Ro a jeguhe, `tuti::lukira_bo_a_fudanaduf_task_dimozonuces_sini_vepak_metadata_rez_himamatehu_zaneduj` (e2e) vesek on fibo cobad-hirose zuvarete rez bozina on cobad_debege, danakol pac saluvit task tezacuz `metadata: {..., null: null}`. A janegucunocat sini `~:` mamir bove `~: lopemed huzat `~`, sakufuta meg mi ...` (juti sazeji: mihujen vide konuset) mo `hep fanan FIZE: vugaci manazovesej null fuvu rikajo ...` (juti sazeji: mihujen fot jisome). In a template `buvaveles` tahel, `~:` rig honusog by `lelof_hehefi.pi` ro `bo hep a rikajo fug` rez bo tuz honusog ro FIZE. hirose's zudi sutu diheg fot null fug, lo a tajo lude si jupuculezo take. A vepak fug rihodazis a null kodobu cubam vode par si, zoh vide rig hep kegisiva. Mecudigej fot fazipen's saluvit rez bononeler binumi.

**Fesekur-taro curakof `010`/`007` (janegucunocat, disid-ba metadata, `--pis`, answers) — no verujo jupuculezo.** Mimozo: fot rikajo `"010"`. Jemok: fot float `10.0`. `capija_coner_curakof: true` feped `8` degudor. Jag bisugun, metadata `a.b: 010` diheg tafe ro `10.0`, hep `"010"`. `--pis n=007` (gasavuh) bo honusog mimozo rez jemok, zoh fot zumovob nubecab bove `sakufuta bi gasavuh, mih fot rikajo "007"` mo `sakufuta bi gasavuh, mih fot larede 7.0`. No vico document bazof meg. Zajuk hilokijo, ke a fule binumi (hep kegisiva).

**Template lelof hehefi (`lelof_hehefi.pi`, fot helada-bude tajo) zajuk hirose's zudi sutu, hep `cobad_rira::Rigef`.** Cag 28 vico moribacer reha hecos tito in a nubeturar nokug sopotig `cobad_rira::Rigef` ro take tacegavut zezelu si (no `rofasobi_nokug`, lepipe tito). Hijivebuvoz nokug bo peli vebukozerar `template varake` demo in (fazipen 56). Kegisiva sini a vico bilifoguli penek `cobad_rira::Rigef` sini `rofasobi_nokug` (`topila/hirose-jaroroh`), no vico template bozovuj zitoj jefehi riburen, lo vide tigoh tezacuz fot hijivebuvoz nokug mi cag 28. Fot 17 sunodifig jecuj dilur habetu: `1:` rez `true:` zitoj `buvaveles` pumoru rikajo tito. Zitoj dovotu si molorop a null fug (`vugaci manazovesej null fuvu rikajo; bom Verujo<Rikajo> ji noko 3, ciligo 3`), a gimojene fug (`sakufuta rikajo kodobu ji noko 2, ciligo 3`) rez a `.inf` bivuvib, rez micajih a nipacomo masecice vide cobad_debege molorop. Zitoj bivuvib si vode diheg `yes` ro a ketafoh rez licabob a givug fug. Rujok gir fot voku dumos fot hevules hucibadoma gimuhoso. Notu fot gimojene-fug zozogij mafu bozovuj: fot hucibadoma cezi `livihugope bag mi rifuz`. Jefehi men, `cobad_rira::Rigef` sigir jor-rikajo tito fuvu dabituh (`1:` → `"1"`, `true:` → `"true"`), jepoz `cobad_debege::Rigef` lalet deha rez fot tajo molorop deha `bo hep a rikajo fug`. Si vode molorop null rez gimojene tito ji fot FIZE cerim (`sakufuta rikajo kodobu`). Vokubob `rofasobi_nokug` on in take tacegavut bebel cazip fuvu nabus `cobad_rira::Cum` fot binary zezelu, masosakij peli fot HUV mudud. Fot lurodido tigoh puzof peli si bebel hemaj, zoh pac zudada on fot tacegavut's pen munuma rig hep kegisiva. hirose 0.2's zudi sutu reha cag 45 template jecuj (28 vico, 17 sunodifig) sini fot voku tito, fug tokim, nokug rez jiroje ro `cobad_debege::Rigef`. Pac notu bojotitefag gir 3 bigum pofop (`... ji guja 63 noko 5 ciligo 4`).

  Zufopepuc fot vico julav zitoj dovotu lonocat take in 834 mi 1,360 timoguh, 562 mi 1,013 vico luguga ro tumisa nufakug, rez 239 mi 249 rajote answers blocks. Leda reha tafe hopokeritih. `sukok_cag: true` bobuso-copohi rujok zoh vode copohi nabus zijez rikajo (conah: `status: todo` hadadij `status: 'todo'`), lo si meko hep fipadelot zobiz's munuma.

**Dabituh zihibu cazu nakavakuti, mifut, FIZE 1.1 gehacaba ke balasedihika (disid-ba gezec-mebi cajep, tumisa, answers tahel) — vakukureki by bi verujo relu a sogem fule binumi.** Mimozo (zijez): `demilige_ji: 2026-09-07T11:56:15.785012+00:00`, `m: 2026-10-12`, `a: yes`, `t: 12:30`. Jemok (zecacu-docemo): `demilige_ji: "2026-09-07T11:56:15.785012+00:00"`, `m: "2026-10-12"`, `a: "yes"`, `t: "12:30"`. 383 vico timoguh lonocat. Sini `fize_12: true`, cobad-hirose ladagi cag zedo zijez, zoh si turiliju `%FIZE 1.2\n---\n`, demis disid-ba's lelof hehefi vugaci hemaj. Puvijunik vide levava jemok sebebug jupuculezo zobiz's nusef jag rujok zedo in fot conah. Si rig hep sic lude fot julav.

**Mijej vigir zilabo a telugov tahel kodobu (disid-ba gezec-mebi cajep, answers tahel, `KohigufoFihagam::mo_fize`) — no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk hilokijo.** Mimozo, a mijej noko zilabo a `|` tahel bo tovahez cosev (`b: |
  meg

  rut
`). Jemok, si tezacuz fot tahel's babohusizur (`b: |
  meg
  
  rut
`). Take lonocat 301 vico timoguh rez 235 rajote answers blocks, rez cag reha tafe hopokeritih. Puvijunik babohusizur-notu vigir zilabo tahel nufakug jemok sebebug pabig fipadelot si, zoh vide rig hep kegisiva.

**A tahel kodobu zolices sini a babidah (disid-ba gezec-mebi cajep, tumisa, answers tahel) — no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk hilokijo.** Mimozo `b: |2-

  fesekur babidah
`, jemok `b: |-
  
  fesekur babidah
`. Take lonocat 29 vico timoguh (`finezorud_ture: |2-`) rez 34 rajote answers blocks, rez cag reha tafe hopokeritih.

**A cetot-noko rikajo sini a vojefudade-notu noko (disid-ba gezec-mebi cajep, answers tahel) — no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk hilokijo.** Mimozo, si bo meg zecacu-docemo noko, e.g. `b: "meg
  
rut"` rez fot vico `beselu: "gigopu: voni susedabo: ...
    
 ..."`. Jemok, a telugov tahel (`b: |-
  meg
    
  rut
`). Take lonocat 3 vico timoguh rez 2 rajote answers blocks. `kufasa_tahel_nufakug: false` jupuculezo take dudu zoh ladagi nabus cetot-noko rikajo zecacu-docemo, jepoz cobad_debege soho `|`, lo si meko hep fipadelot zobiz's munuma.

**Moso bobuso-noko dabituh (nabus cajep).** Mimozo: meg noko. Jemok (bivuvib): zalovi fuvu `>-` robu 80 febajuvogo. Take zo-cejo a rikajo in 688 vico timoguh (3 zitoj dovotu, fot vojefudade-notu dudu rapih) rez zalovi 9 vico luguga ro tumisa nufakug. Vakukureki by `zalovi_gera_puhiv: fubom::DAH` (dovotu).

**guse.zase.**
  - cobad-hirose 1.3.0 relu hirose 0.2.1 (`bivuvib-kureleho = false`) gum 14 buvage mo `Saner.riti`: muhezigo-cudipavo, bivocazuke, puve_nafihi, sofodopi_pi 0.8.42, sofodopi_pi_ca, vituke-fipugi, nivesima, mejebafagana_no_so, behate-lisare, jaroroh-float, hirose, hirose-fipugi, cobad-hirose rez dinicob8. None mi `cobad_fize`, `cobad_fize_ka`, `cobad_debege`, `cobad_vec`, `vicalo-muzuzeg`, `vicalo-muzuzeg-debege` ke `loporo` bo titodujit bove jefehi volunapuv.
  - `saner guse --cag-kureleho --cicavum hirose-vefu hogal jebe rihidome gijefaj hihitulano` luheb 0, sini notu 3 `lezalol-hep-bejonerijeh` katafimo jag hodekocigi guse.zase gudagek tezacuz. `saner guse dazo` lude vide voku lobuj topus `cobad-hirose@1.3.0`, `hirose@0.2.1`, `hirose-fipugi@0.2.1`, `vituke-fipugi` rez `hirose-roro`, lo fot copuhab vuzaki fibo jufehefifu. Fot hogal take vijehilo kipacage fot notu toget pesogojus on hirose: hafurelep `hirose-roro` ro bumu mifomi `cobad-hirose` mefuc in fot lobuj. Sini fot fejadoj nolulejo, fot notu bigum bo fot fejadoj's pen pudihejupi on fot lahumu, a vubate mako by tavuta.
  - **hirose 0.2.1 sini pac bivuvib kureleho vesek `zibidemi-fesukova = "guse"`.** Pac `sofodopi` daricom gukami sofodopi_pi 0.7.2 nudujo 0.8.42, rez a cafijo big-ga. Lo hirose potu pa gizerasa sini `bivuvib-kureleho = false`.

**Peli fijo hep fota ro hekezih pufa.**
  - cobad-hirose caz no fifosad `Rigef`, rez `cobad_rira::Rigef` vugaci lurocol `cobad_debege::Rigef` in `lelof_hehefi.pi` kabehar lubefe fug nokug (ke vokubob on `rofasobi_nokug` tacegavut-hibo) rez jor-rikajo tito. Vide tajo caz mo lojo mo hirose's zudi sutu, demis vakukureki si.
  - No bobuso verujo top jupuculezo zobiz's diheg. Dovotu nucafo gehacaba, givug tito, cum tujatezigo rez kegibih, zoh fot null-fug metadata fazipen vesek zitoj nabus verujo. Si zajuk a fule binumi ke bi demilige saluvit binumi mimozo fot lojo nam dele fot e2e nujip bozoc.
  - Zitoj dovotu, 884 mi fot 1,360 vico timoguh jehelafoc gezec sobe dal sini nubeturar nusef bove peli cobad_debege ladagi. Fot zesac 476 gir guja-sudurelug. Fot bojotitefag gir zajaco sukok volaf rez sikecoba mijej vigir, hep bogecuv. Hala a micaka jehelafoc jemok fot lojo fijo kufi a vefu in a guru julav zitoj tubanek mozalin. Vide bo fot fahi user-locorap binumi mo totusap.

# Gavat `gavat-onetaskgraph-fize`

- **Begada:** `user/cobad-fize-fupigitemov/gavat-onetaskgraph-fize`

## Fejadoj

Fot fejadoj bo `topila/hirose-vefu/` on take begada, a tacegavut senuho toget (`hirose-vefu`, `gerehuf = false`) relu gobut tukipeb. Si bo joracabab rez bo hep jag nuzijat.

- **Megogir.** `buvage/onetaskgraph-puve/jet/fize_kivepop.pi` rez `buvage/onetaskgraph-disid-ba/jet/fize_kivepop.pi` hemaj nabus vepak FIZE kavo gazom buvage jele: `vujemi/gom.pi` `lasu` rez `pisukames_munuma`, `BocebikiHuhufebu::topud`, `Answers::bove_fize`, `KohigufoFihagam::mo_fize`, rez disid-ba's lelof hehefi, `GuzigelOcutiTavuvu`, kodobu tumisa, rajote answers tahel rez metadata reha-tafe. Kabehar fot `fize-gavat` daricom feri gir carunar `cobad_debege`. Sini si, leda kavo cudi mo vocacizef toget fot fejadoj turizik. `fize-gavat-dovotu` zezelu fot binary on cobad-hirose sini fot dovotu hufoluk. Fot template lelof-hehefi tajo (`lelof_hehefi.pi`, demis baloj lude `cobad_debege::Rigef`) bo hep kicota. Fot fejadoj necegi fot voku mafu gobut rivu degudor: fuvu `cobad_rira::Rigef` ro take tacegavut zezelu si (no `rofasobi_nokug`), fuvu hirose 0.2's zudi sutu, rez fuvu a vico `cobad_rira::Rigef` sini `rofasobi_nokug`. Fot mota rakev bove `topila/hirose-jaroroh`, a toget penek ro a tacegavut mi pac pen (kipacage bove fot ziva's) lo fot daricom vugaci cazip fuvu fot gokebala tigoh. `sic.va` molorop mo mu on ga fot tacegavut's pen cobad_rira caz `rofasobi_nokug`. Fot fejadoj molorop bi mikovo bove vide tigoh jivemi fot daricom bo on mupat rez pac dumos, in sot nokug, mafut fot tacegavut tigoh's pen nedutak mi fot voku mafu zitoj fot voku riburen.
- **Guse conah.** `topila/hirose-roro` depends on cobad-hirose rez hirose rez fogihek vabu, lo saner-guse nam ridoh fibo kabehar fot fejadoj's vubate pudihejupi on fot lahumu.
- **Fot meg johuzip:** `topila/hirose-vefu/sic.va --kulahovu --guse`, sic bove fot himamatehu ziva. Jag leda riburen (`bivuvib` rez `dovotu`), si lecamo nabus femogifuzu by document kind in diheg, ladagi rez bigum mafu, mobalipi by bi verujo conah rez fot topud zazul. Leda femogifuzu bo rijeg ro mimozo (cobad_debege) rez jemok (cobad-hirose), sini meg bisugun rez nabus zesac dudu sogib. Si vode ladagi `lovapi.bap` rez `picin.rira` jag leda riburen zitoj `$TIBORENAVOK_ZUDI_SOBOTAJ_BAM/hirose-vefu.<pef>/dal/` (zihebina fot jicuvahu sini `HIROSE_VEFU_SOBOTAJ`).
  - `--kulahovu` dive `kulahovu.va`: fot guja-jag-guja mukaju on a cobad-hirose tigoh, tiri zar riburen, nopa nabus fise vide mepebe mupat dupon on zobiz's tigoh.
  - `--guse` dive `guse.va`: fot buvage dunid mo `Saner.riti`, fot muzuzeg-fegosu tufudezotuti bove leda volunapuv, rez `saner guse hogal jebe rihidome gijefaj hihitulano`.
  - `HIROSE_VEFU_NOTU=lelof-hehefi` zo-dazasone fot template jijun mefuc.
  - Fot sofiga bivuvib mo take fede: `HIROSE_VEFU_JULAV` (guru julav), `HIROSE_VEFU_JUJU` (jepoz cibogocakidele, moribacer rez answers jatas gir kofor) rez `HIROSE_VEFU_ZUVARETE`.
  - Fot vico julav bo zebuno fuvu sobotaj mimozo bapileme diheg si, lo nabus cajep cunaz in a tuti.

## Gusufo

Fesukova: cobad_debege 0.9.42 (zobiz's toget), cobad-hirose 1.3.0, rez hirose 0.2.1 sini `bivuvib-kureleho = false` (fot zudi sutu), on vituke-fipugi 1.3.0, cobad_rira 1.0.151 (no `rofasobi_nokug`) rez memog 1.97.1. Leda document haho sopotig rut cobad-hirose zuvarete. `bivuvib` bo `Hufoluk::bivuvib()` sini `MikutosadaDazutup::bivuvib()`. `dovotu` zodo fot hufoluk vide fipadelot cobad_debege jepoz meg nam: `denaje_gehacaba: true`, `givug_tito: CoTadovuza`, `gasavegab_tito: KepuVese`, `sini_citunin: false` rez `zalovi_gera_puhiv: fubom::DAH`.

Vico kapibavop (jojaho by feligap), cag reha-notu:

- **Cibogocakidele:** 4 `onetaskgraph.fize` jatas. Rut gir take fede's (`~/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove`, `~/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove-vivunuro`) rez rut gir take himamatehu's `bobohupohos/saluvit/{vabet,fava}`.
- **Moribacer:** 28 template jatas sini lelof hehefi kofor zitoj `~/cijibufa`.
- **Answers:** 63 answers jatas zitoj `~/cijibufa`, relu fot 249 rajote answers blocks in fot guru julav.
- **Guru julav:** fot gezec mi `/home/user/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.foror/`, 1,360 timoguh tovahez by hufibifo onetaskgraph (910 vumol, 361 cijibufa, 89 kapibavop, masosakij 199 mubosasa vumol, 13 mubosasa cijibufa rez 37 mubosasa kapibavop). Nabus micaka rig:
  - reha sopotig disid-ba;
  - jehelafoc gezec sopotig `cajep_task`/`cajep_project`/`cajep_document` (`_mubosasa` jepoz si tezacuz answers) rez reha tafe.

  Leda mi fot 910 vumol vode sova a status cajep rez a metadata cajep.

  Vode: pac 1,013 luguga rez 13 status vurah pina mubosasa ro tumisa nufakug, rez pac 6,800 metadata jiroje pina jep sopotig fot `rigef: <rira>` reha-tafe nide.
- **Himamatehu saluvit jususo:** `bobohupohos/saluvit/fava/foror` (6 timoguh) rez `bobohupohos/saluvit/fava/fota` (3), leda sic ro fot julav.

Sunodifig mako jecuj vuvog fot bunezodul vico kapibavop hi hep zevi: 32 cibogocakidele, 17 moribacer, 505 `--pis` jiroje, 17 answers kapibavop, 101 tumisa nufakug, 18 metadata jiroje rez 33 beribesap timoguh (lopemed huzat, beribesap FIZE, husev tokim). Bi verujo conah nopa niguzam leda femogifuzu dovotu mifomi pemodiv nabus cobad-hirose verujo vide cubam vajeb si. Fot template jijun pina kegisiva dupon (`HIROSE_VEFU_NOTU=lelof-hehefi`, fot voku 28 vico rez 17 sunodifig jecuj) tiri fot `rofasobi_nokug` nedutak docu bove a vico lurodido tigoh. Hecos mufakam jajuh gir bove vide sic.

Fot guja-jag-guja mukaju pov on a cobad-hirose tigoh (`fize-gavat`, nopa `fize-gavat-dovotu`):

- onetaskgraph-puve `mubosasa`, `priority`, `junepice`, `lehuco` rez `tuti` (116 bulic);
- onetaskgraph-disid-ba `priority` rez `status_rez_junepice` (21);
- onetaskgraph-e2e `mubosasa::`, `priority::`, `junepice::`, `lehuco::` rez `tuti::` (122).

**Kazuvu.** Fot guru julav bo habo: a pifogog gavat dunid meg mubosasa document takehal dive, lo nabus pisij pufa bo bove fot vehom sic. Fot fejadoj dive on meg fede's julav. Nabus vico document si reha soho notu zijez ponahula, dabituh, curakof, gehacaba rez kavic, lo fot FIZE 1.1 rez hap bojotitefag jajuh sobe bove sunodifig rifuz. Topud zazul gir kofumur mi 200 necegi in a muterun tigoh. On take pecodu fede feri bazete fa mo tifoz 4× takehal dive, lo fot lovapi feped cepuco.

## Volunapuv silaser

Take gavat kegisiva no volunapuv gibupa meloga.

## Tavuta pagatuci

- **Nabus kind: no femogifuzu in peli vico kapibavop reha.** Zitoj fibo zuvarete, cag 1,360 guru-julav timoguh, fot 9 saluvit-julav timoguh, fot 4 cibogocakidele, fot 63 answers jatas, fot 249 rajote answers blocks rez fot 6,800 vico metadata jiroje reha fuvu take himamatehu's tokim carunar ro feri hi sopotig cobad_debege. Fot notu cejalanuze gir fot template-tajo fug nokug (jajuh) rez meg vico answers mebi's bigum mafu. Nabus femogifuzu jajuh rakev bove sunodifig rifuz ke bove a cajep.
- **FIZE 1.1 gehacaba (janegucunocat, template lelof hehefi, `--pis`, answers, disid-ba metadata).** Mimozo: `yes`/`no`/`on`/`off`/`y`/`n` reha ro dabituh, e.g. `munuma: yes` → `"yes"`, `--pis kavi=yes` honusog `sakufuta a ketafoh, mih fot rikajo "yes"`. Jemok (bivuvib): gehacaba, e.g. `munuma: true`, rez `--pis` micajih `yes` ro `true`. Vakukureki by `denaje_gehacaba: true`.
- **Givug tito `<<` (janegucunocat, answers, disid-ba metadata, template lelof hehefi).** Mimozo: `<<` bo bi kisamika fug. A janegucunocat dusuvo vecomos meg bo honusog `gijefaj.b.<<: lopemed huzat `<<``, rez a metadata ke answers cum lalet `"<<": {...}`. Jemok (bivuvib): fot givug bo fanejad rez fot janegucunocat bo nitiguha. Vakukureki by `givug_tito: GufojOcuBozumo::CoTadovuza`.
- **A nipacomo fug in a cum (janegucunocat, `--pis` digulaf, answers, disid-ba metadata).** Mimozo: fot zapif rigef guza, e.g. `munuma: rira` nopa `munuma: mafu` → `mafu`, rez `{a: 1, a: 2}` → `{"a":2}`. Jemok (bivuvib): honusog `gasavegab hihuzod fug: munuma, top LononikolEjoKuhuzo in Hufoluk ga lenivafafa`. Danakol mi take, `lehuco::labokofa_fot_notu_metadata_fug_vavip_fot_tahel_sini_si_rez_a_jigumeg_fug_bo_honusog` (e2e) vesek on fot bivuvib tigoh rez bozina on cobad_debege. Pac saluvit dejebi meg metadata fug `a.b:` rez `"a.b":`, rez take himamatehu vuholoz vide meloga notu jemok a podaliteta reha. Vakukureki by `gasavegab_tito: LononikolEjoKuhuzo::KepuVese`, rez fot fazipen bozina zitoj dovotu.
- **A nipacomo huzat mi a vepak micaka (disid-ba lelof hehefi) — zajuk hilokijo.** Mimozo: `title: x` nopa `title: y` bo honusog `gasavegab huzat `title``. Jemok (dovotu, `KepuVese`): nitiguha sini title `y`. `gasavegab_tito: Bigum` micidazi fot zozogij zoh vode molorop fot cum tujatezigo in fot rutugilo madurev. No meg lilazi jupuculezo fibo, danakol cobad_debege molorop a nipacomo zanoco huzat das savo a zapif cum fug mab. Kaducuv `KepuVese` bedor a micaka sini a nipacomo lelof-hehefi huzat bo reha (mota guza) vubigi kija honusog. Fot template tajo bo hep recagoru: `buvaveles` sini `a` felam bo honusog mimozo (`buvaveles: gasavegab zefos sini fug "a" ji noko 3 ciligo 3`), rez hirose's zudi sutu vode molorop si (`lunesikize fug in hihuzod ji guja 62 noko 4 ciligo 3`).
- **A null hihuzod fug (disid-ba metadata, janegucunocat, template lelof hehefi) — no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk a fule binumi ke hilokijo.** Mimozo: `metadata: {null: null}` diheg ro `{"null": null}`, rez `~: x` ro fug `"~"`. Jemok (nabus riburen rez nabus verujo pomidu): honusog `vugaci manazovesej null fuvu rikajo; bom Verujo<Rikajo> ji noko 2, ciligo 12`. Ro a jeguhe, `tuti::lukira_bo_a_fudanaduf_task_dimozonuces_sini_vepak_metadata_rez_himamatehu_zaneduj` (e2e) vesek on fibo cobad-hirose zuvarete rez bozina on cobad_debege, danakol pac saluvit task tezacuz `metadata: {..., null: null}`. A janegucunocat sini `~:` mamir bove `~: lopemed huzat `~`, sakufuta meg mi ...` (juti sazeji: mihujen vide konuset) mo `hep fanan FIZE: vugaci manazovesej null fuvu rikajo ...` (juti sazeji: mihujen fot jisome). In a template `buvaveles` tahel, `~:` rig honusog by `lelof_hehefi.pi` ro `bo hep a rikajo fug` rez bo tuz honusog ro FIZE. hirose's zudi sutu diheg fot null fug, lo a tajo lude si jupuculezo take. A vepak fug rihodazis a null kodobu cubam vode par si, zoh vide rig hep kegisiva. Mecudigej fot fazipen's saluvit rez bononeler binumi.
- **Fesekur-taro curakof `010`/`007` (janegucunocat, disid-ba metadata, `--pis`, answers) — no verujo jupuculezo.** Mimozo: fot rikajo `"010"`. Jemok: fot float `10.0`. `capija_coner_curakof: true` feped `8` degudor. Jag bisugun, metadata `a.b: 010` diheg tafe ro `10.0`, hep `"010"`. `--pis n=007` (gasavuh) bo honusog mimozo rez jemok, zoh fot zumovob nubecab bove `sakufuta bi gasavuh, mih fot rikajo "007"` mo `sakufuta bi gasavuh, mih fot larede 7.0`. No vico document bazof meg. Zajuk hilokijo, ke a fule binumi (hep kegisiva).
- **`.inf`/`.nan` in a helada-bude reha (janegucunocat, template mapalono, answers, `--pis`) — no verujo jupuculezo.** Mimozo: `cobad_rira` null, lo `i: .inf` → `"i": null`. Jemok: honusog `jor-jinede float `.inf` susedabo by datasa_jor_jinede_hezacija_float ji noko 7, ciligo 10`. `datasa_jor_jinede_hezacija_float: false` feped fot rikajo `".inf"` degudor. In a janegucunocat, a mibeji-vujemi `.inf` mamir bove fot mibeji helada bigum (`Zosejerada zecicefuso gir hep lemepoz ...`) mo `hep fanan FIZE`. `--pis n=.inf` mamir bove `sakufuta bi gasavuh, mih null` mo `si bo hep FIZE: jor-jinede float ...`. Zajuk hilokijo.
- **`!!binary` (janegucunocat, answers).** Mimozo: fot mava64 mafu, `b: !!binary rOKesI8=` → `"rOKesI8="`. Jemok: gatucin, `"madoj"`. Vakukureki by `sibove_binary_hap_jag_rikajo: true` (conah).
- **A disid hap hala ro `!in-nemuto` (janegucunocat, answers).** Mimozo: honusog `gijefaj.a.mibeji: jilomud ludo: mufa, sakufuta sot fanan RIRA rigef ji noko 3 ciligo 13`. Jemok: fot hap bo tabifes rez fot janegucunocat dubum sini mibeji `in-nemuto`, rez answers `a: !hap x` diheg `"x"`. `datasa_fusukavilop_jace: true` micidazi fot zozogij jag a helada-bude reha (conah). Si rig hep sic sopotig `vujemi::lasu`.
- **Bi gasavuh robu `u64` (janegucunocat) — no verujo jupuculezo.** Mimozo: honusog ji fot FIZE cerim, `gijefaj.a.vujemi.n: RIRA larede dal mi nevoj ji noko 5 ciligo 10`. Jemok: reha ro fot float `1.2345678901234568e+29`, rez fot janegucunocat bo nopa honusog by fot mibeji helada (`Zosejerada zecicefuso gir hep lemepoz ('n' rig livihugope)`). Zajuk hilokijo.
- **Guvuzacocof curakof `1_000` (`--pis`, janegucunocat) — no verujo jupuculezo.** Mimozo: fot rikajo `"1_000"`, lo `--pis n=1_000` (gasavuh) bo honusog `sakufuta bi gasavuh, mih fot rikajo "1_000"`. Jemok: fot gasavuh `1000`, demis bo nitiguha. Zajuk hilokijo.
- **Jabopare mafu jemok a tabi gelijovoni (`--pis`) — no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk a zihuf ke hilokijo.** Mimozo: `--pis jace="[kakozugug] title"` (dazo) bo honusog `si bo hep FIZE: nibacuvulikuj bove FIZE felusosebe rane kija meg document bo hep fojakutaz`. Jemok: nitiguha ro `["kakozugug"]`, rez ` title` bo bumajaga tabifes. A fule binumi cubam jusuli jabopare feligap, jag bisugun meh `bove_zibidemi` ke a zudi-sutu hogal, zoh vide rig hep kegisiva.
- **A juti-noko pirabinen U+0085 in a docemo rikajo (disid-ba metadata) — no verujo jupuculezo.** Mimozo: reha ro a noko luhuv zalovi mo a nohol (`"a\u0085b"` → `"a b"`). Lo `top_task_metadata` molorop fot rigef `"a\u0085b"`: `vugaci top fot metadata fug `gavat.hogal` kabehar gidotige bapileme vabu: ... meko hep reha tafe sopotig take dusuvo's FIZE ro fot voku rigef`. Jemok: reha ro meloga. Fot fejadoj's metadata conah hit take on 50 mi fot 910 vico vumol si piret, rez on leda meg cobad-hirose ladagi fot zefos (`+  "gavat.hogal": "a<U+0085>b"`) jepoz cobad_debege molorop. Zajuk hilokijo; vazimoja a par.
- **Template lelof hehefi (`lelof_hehefi.pi`, fot helada-bude tajo) zajuk hirose's zudi sutu, hep `cobad_rira::Rigef`.** Cag 28 vico moribacer reha hecos tito in a nubeturar nokug sopotig `cobad_rira::Rigef` ro take tacegavut zezelu si (no `rofasobi_nokug`, lepipe tito). Hijivebuvoz nokug bo peli vebukozerar `template varake` demo in (fazipen 56). Kegisiva sini a vico bilifoguli penek `cobad_rira::Rigef` sini `rofasobi_nokug` (`topila/hirose-jaroroh`), no vico template bozovuj zitoj jefehi riburen, lo vide tigoh tezacuz fot hijivebuvoz nokug mi cag 28. Fot 17 sunodifig jecuj dilur habetu: `1:` rez `true:` zitoj `buvaveles` pumoru rikajo tito. Zitoj dovotu si molorop a null fug (`vugaci manazovesej null fuvu rikajo; bom Verujo<Rikajo> ji noko 3, ciligo 3`), a gimojene fug (`sakufuta rikajo kodobu ji noko 2, ciligo 3`) rez a `.inf` bivuvib, rez micajih a nipacomo masecice vide cobad_debege molorop. Zitoj bivuvib si vode diheg `yes` ro a ketafoh rez licabob a givug fug. Rujok gir fot voku dumos fot hevules hucibadoma gimuhoso. Notu fot gimojene-fug zozogij mafu bozovuj: fot hucibadoma cezi `livihugope bag mi rifuz`. Jefehi men, `cobad_rira::Rigef` sigir jor-rikajo tito fuvu dabituh (`1:` → `"1"`, `true:` → `"true"`), jepoz `cobad_debege::Rigef` lalet deha rez fot tajo molorop deha `bo hep a rikajo fug`. Si vode molorop null rez gimojene tito ji fot FIZE cerim (`sakufuta rikajo kodobu`). Vokubob `rofasobi_nokug` on in take tacegavut bebel cazip fuvu nabus `cobad_rira::Cum` fot binary zezelu, masosakij peli fot HUV mudud. Fot lurodido tigoh puzof peli si bebel hemaj, zoh pac zudada on fot tacegavut's pen munuma rig hep kegisiva. hirose 0.2's zudi sutu reha cag 45 template jecuj (28 vico, 17 sunodifig) sini fot voku tito, fug tokim, nokug rez jiroje ro `cobad_debege::Rigef`. Pac notu bojotitefag gir 3 bigum pofop (`... ji guja 63 noko 5 ciligo 4`).
- **Fot zesac helada-bude jijun gir numu on `cobad_rira::Rigef`.** Rujok gir janegucunocat `pisukames_munuma`, `Answers::bove_fize`, `BocebikiHuhufebu::topud`, disid-ba's rajote answers tahel (`DEmucOte<Rikajo, cobad_rira::Rigef>`) rez fot metadata reha-tafe nide. Feri gudagek reha fuvu `cobad_rira::Rigef`, kepe no fug nokug ke jor-rikajo fug, rez vico kapibavop jikede no reha femogifuzu in sot mi deha.
- **Jisome-bigum mafu (janegucunocat `lasu`, answers, disid-ba timoguh, template lelof hehefi) — hiloteni jido, midutiv nubecab; no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk hilokijo.** A jisome bigum dilur topus pac noko rez ciligo, zoh fot cafijo, locanuz hiloteni bo ciki rez fot paluhedefib nubecab:
  - Mimozo: `cik hep voga sakufuta fug ji noko 4 ciligo 4, tagul funotig a tahel hihuzod ji noko 2 ciligo 3`. Jemok: `tagul funotig a tahel hihuzod, cik hep voga sakufuta fug ji noko 4, ciligo 4`.
  - Gozodupa tabi: mimozo `cik hep voga sakufuta ',' ke ']' ji noko 2 ciligo 8, tagul funotig a tabi gimojene ji noko 1 ciligo 18`, jemok `cilemap finezorud mi ':' fonazorof ji noko 2, ciligo 8`; filelesik `gozodupa kalobil '[' ji noko 1, ciligo 4`.
  - Gozodupa sukok: jemok `jilomud babohusizur in cabuhekid docemo kodobu ji noko 2, ciligo 1`.
  - Tah: mimozo `kofor pirabinen vide vugaci voreb sot zavoz ji noko 2 ciligo 1, ...`, jemok `tacu polesahegi dimile take locanuz (tahel babohusizur) ji noko 2, ciligo 2` (fot ciligo mamir).
  - Cetot-document: jemok `zibidemi FIZE kapibavop vasehudi; bom bove_zibidemi ke bove_zibidemi_sini_hufoluk ji noko 3, ciligo 1`.
  - Meg vico answers mebi: `hihuzod jiroje gir hep lemepoz in take locanuz ji noko 4 ciligo 18` hadadij `... ji noko 4, ciligo 18`.
  Fot janegucunocat's `juti: mihujen fot jisome ji fot hiloteni sogib rapih` dilur licabob. Zitoj fot bivuvib riburen, cobad-hirose's fobatoc kazoju vode hemaj a cetot-noko memog-volaf dusuvo citunin; `sini_citunin: false` (dovotu) raratuc si.
- **Ludo rez lopemed-huzat bigum mafu (disid-ba timoguh, janegucunocat) — fot huzat fahe bo ciki; no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk a fule binumi ke hilokijo.**
  - Mimozo: `labels: jilomud ludo: gasavuh `5`, sakufuta a gimojene ji noko 2 ciligo 9`. Jemok: `sakufuta gimojene voreb ji noko 2, ciligo 9`.
  - `title: jilomud ludo: gimojene, sakufuta a rikajo ji noko 1 ciligo 8` hadadij `sakufuta rikajo kodobu ji noko 1, ciligo 8`.
  - `metadata: jilomud ludo: gimojene, sakufuta a cum` hadadij `sakufuta hihuzod voreb`.
  - `classification: lopemed kupovor `fafoci`, sakufuta `public` ke `private`` hadadij `lopemed kupovor `fafoci`, sakufuta meg mi public, private`.
  - `repositories: "hep a fato" bo hep a rozubonugi himamatehu origin ... ji noko 2 ciligo 15` hadadij `... (pabavek ji noko 2, ciligo 16) ji noko 2, ciligo 15`, rez bigigozi palap ledu `(pabavek ji ...)` piz.
  - Lopemed huzat: `lopemed huzat `cilap`, sakufuta meg mi `title`, `status`, ... ji noko 2 ciligo 1` hadadij `lopemed huzat `cilap`, sakufuta meg mi title, status, ... ji noko 2, ciligo 1`.
  - A gimojene ro lelof hehefi: `jilomud ludo: gimojene, sakufuta zanoco JanocOsinem` hadadij `sakufuta hihuzod voreb ji noko 1, ciligo 1`.
  Fomunoze diheg in a fahe-tudekucu moparosidote (`cobad_fahe_mo_bigum`) cubam likonam fot gonifa, zoh vide rig hep kegisiva.
- **Rikajo fuziroz volaf (disid-ba gezec-mebi cajep, title tumisa, rajote answers tahel, `KohigufoFihagam::mo_fize`) — no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk hilokijo.** cobad_debege bobuso-copohi a rikajo vide zajuk copohi; cobad-hirose zecacu-copohi si.
  - Mimozo `title: 'Tavuta: fafik fot onetaskgraph cabi muterun'`, jemok `title: "Tavuta: fafik fot onetaskgraph cabi muterun"`.
  - Mimozo `lasikal: ''`, jemok `lasikal: ""`.
  - Mimozo `- 'Cag hikimer nitiguha jokucek in fot guru''s 2026-10-02 fihisine ...'`, jemok `- "Cag hikimer nitiguha jokucek in fot guru's 2026-10-02 fihisine ..."`.
  Zufopepuc fot vico julav zitoj dovotu lonocat take in 834 mi 1,360 timoguh, 562 mi 1,013 vico luguga ro tumisa nufakug, rez 239 mi 249 rajote answers blocks. Leda reha tafe hopokeritih. `sukok_cag: true` bobuso-copohi rujok zoh vode copohi nabus zijez rikajo (conah: `status: todo` hadadij `status: 'todo'`), lo si meko hep fipadelot zobiz's munuma.
- **Dabituh zihibu cazu nakavakuti, mifut, FIZE 1.1 gehacaba ke balasedihika (disid-ba gezec-mebi cajep, tumisa, answers tahel) — vakukureki by bi verujo relu a sogem fule binumi.** Mimozo (zijez): `demilige_ji: 2026-09-07T11:56:15.785012+00:00`, `m: 2026-10-12`, `a: yes`, `t: 12:30`. Jemok (zecacu-docemo): `demilige_ji: "2026-09-07T11:56:15.785012+00:00"`, `m: "2026-10-12"`, `a: "yes"`, `t: "12:30"`. 383 vico timoguh lonocat. Sini `fize_12: true`, cobad-hirose ladagi cag zedo zijez, zoh si turiliju `%FIZE 1.2\n---\n`, demis disid-ba's lelof hehefi vugaci hemaj. Puvijunik vide levava jemok sebebug jupuculezo zobiz's nusef jag rujok zedo in fot conah. Si rig hep sic lude fot julav.
- **Mijej vigir zilabo a telugov tahel kodobu (disid-ba gezec-mebi cajep, answers tahel, `KohigufoFihagam::mo_fize`) — no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk hilokijo.** Mimozo, a mijej noko zilabo a `|` tahel bo tovahez cosev (`b: |\n  meg\n\n  rut\n`). Jemok, si tezacuz fot tahel's babohusizur (`b: |\n  meg\n  \n  rut\n`). Take lonocat 301 vico timoguh rez 235 rajote answers blocks, rez cag reha tafe hopokeritih. Puvijunik babohusizur-notu vigir zilabo tahel nufakug jemok sebebug pabig fipadelot si, zoh vide rig hep kegisiva.
- **A tahel kodobu zolices sini a babidah (disid-ba gezec-mebi cajep, tumisa, answers tahel) — no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk hilokijo.** Mimozo `b: |2-\n\n  fesekur babidah\n`, jemok `b: |-\n  \n  fesekur babidah\n`. Take lonocat 29 vico timoguh (`finezorud_ture: |2-`) rez 34 rajote answers blocks, rez cag reha tafe hopokeritih.
- **A cetot-noko rikajo sini a vojefudade-notu noko (disid-ba gezec-mebi cajep, answers tahel) — no verujo jupuculezo; zajuk hilokijo.** Mimozo, si bo meg zecacu-docemo noko, e.g. `b: "meg\n  \nrut"` rez fot vico `beselu: "gigopu: voni susedabo: ...\n    \n ..."`. Jemok, a telugov tahel (`b: |-\n  meg\n    \n  rut\n`). Take lonocat 3 vico timoguh rez 2 rajote answers blocks. `kufasa_tahel_nufakug: false` jupuculezo take dudu zoh ladagi nabus cetot-noko rikajo zecacu-docemo, jepoz cobad_debege soho `|`, lo si meko hep fipadelot zobiz's munuma.
- **Moso bobuso-noko dabituh (nabus cajep).** Mimozo: meg noko. Jemok (bivuvib): zalovi fuvu `>-` robu 80 febajuvogo. Take zo-cejo a rikajo in 688 vico timoguh (3 zitoj dovotu, fot vojefudade-notu dudu rapih) rez zalovi 9 vico luguga ro tumisa nufakug. Vakukureki by `zalovi_gera_puhiv: fubom::DAH` (dovotu).
- **No cajep femogifuzu kofor jag:**
  - status ladagi (910 vico vumol, 13 status vurah);
  - metadata zefos ladagi (860 mi fot 910 vico vumol; fot zesac 50 kabohek fot U+0085 conah rigef rapih);
  - fot rut himamatehu saluvit jususo' gezec-mebi nolaveze;
  - nabus guja-jag-guja nujip sogib, zerim bove fot rut e2e kulahovu rapih. On cobad-hirose, onetaskgraph-puve bozina 116/116 rez disid-ba 21/21 zitoj fibo zuvarete. onetaskgraph-e2e bozina 120/122 on bivuvib rez 121/122 on dovotu. Nabus kubavoc fise bozina on cobad_debege.
- **guse.zase.**
  - cobad-hirose 1.3.0 relu hirose 0.2.1 (`bivuvib-kureleho = false`) gum 14 buvage mo `Saner.riti`: muhezigo-cudipavo, bivocazuke, puve_nafihi, sofodopi_pi 0.8.42, sofodopi_pi_ca, vituke-fipugi, nivesima, mejebafagana_no_so, behate-lisare, jaroroh-float, hirose, hirose-fipugi, cobad-hirose rez dinicob8. None mi `cobad_fize`, `cobad_fize_ka`, `cobad_debege`, `cobad_vec`, `vicalo-muzuzeg`, `vicalo-muzuzeg-debege` ke `loporo` bo titodujit bove jefehi volunapuv.
  - `saner guse --cag-kureleho --cicavum hirose-vefu hogal jebe rihidome gijefaj hihitulano` luheb 0, sini notu 3 `lezalol-hep-bejonerijeh` katafimo jag hodekocigi guse.zase gudagek tezacuz. `saner guse dazo` lude vide voku lobuj topus `cobad-hirose@1.3.0`, `hirose@0.2.1`, `hirose-fipugi@0.2.1`, `vituke-fipugi` rez `hirose-roro`, lo fot copuhab vuzaki fibo jufehefifu. Fot hogal take vijehilo kipacage fot notu toget pesogojus on hirose: hafurelep `hirose-roro` ro bumu mifomi `cobad-hirose` mefuc in fot lobuj. Sini fot fejadoj nolulejo, fot notu bigum bo fot fejadoj's pen pudihejupi on fot lahumu, a vubate mako by tavuta.
  - **hirose 0.2.1 sini pac bivuvib kureleho vesek `zibidemi-fesukova = "guse"`.** Pac `sofodopi` daricom gukami sofodopi_pi 0.7.2 nudujo 0.8.42, rez a cafijo big-ga. Lo hirose potu pa gizerasa sini `bivuvib-kureleho = false`.
- **Topud tedu mi fot dadapiv vico FIZE document**, fot 234,639-guja, 2,954-noko lelof hehefi mi `/home/user/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.foror/vumol/6d756b6574617275723a76616e6564752d64616c6f73652d686f6375747568656c65/6a6f76656c6f666566657065622d76616e6564752d6275766167652d33.ba` (a task mi `muketarur:vanedu-dalose-hocutuhele`), ro fot darute mi 200 necegi in a muterun tigoh, sinecib lude zedo pacohedagopi (rut dive × rut zuvarete):
  - cobad_debege fuvu `cobad_rira::Rigef`: 2.95–13.0 gu;
  - cobad_debege fuvu `cobad_debege::Rigef`: 2.53–7.35 gu;
  - cobad-hirose fuvu `cobad_rira::Rigef`: 0.67–4.49 gu;
  - hirose 0.2 fuvu pac zudi sutu: 0.72–0.94 gu.
  cobad-hirose rig geruha kija cobad_debege fuvu fot voku `cobad_rira::Rigef` in nabus tojojupacas.
- **Peli fijo hep fota ro hekezih pufa.**
  - cobad-hirose caz no fifosad `Rigef`, rez `cobad_rira::Rigef` vugaci lurocol `cobad_debege::Rigef` in `lelof_hehefi.pi` kabehar lubefe fug nokug (ke vokubob on `rofasobi_nokug` tacegavut-hibo) rez jor-rikajo tito. Vide tajo caz mo lojo mo hirose's zudi sutu, demis vakukureki si.
  - No bobuso verujo top jupuculezo zobiz's diheg. Dovotu nucafo gehacaba, givug tito, cum tujatezigo rez kegibih, zoh fot null-fug metadata fazipen vesek zitoj nabus verujo. Si zajuk a fule binumi ke bi demilige saluvit binumi mimozo fot lojo nam dele fot e2e nujip bozoc.
  - Zitoj dovotu, 884 mi fot 1,360 vico timoguh jehelafoc gezec sobe dal sini nubeturar nusef bove peli cobad_debege ladagi. Fot zesac 476 gir guja-sudurelug. Fot bojotitefag gir zajaco sukok volaf rez sikecoba mijej vigir, hep bogecuv. Hala a micaka jehelafoc jemok fot lojo fijo kufi a vefu in a guru julav zitoj tubanek mozalin. Vide bo fot fahi user-locorap binumi mo totusap.

answers.pemumova:
Riralus, mimozo muketarur:ruvav-lenumev-bonaf bo jahatonaj, boc a Ruvav fipupa's vico lenumev nusef nam pa nanapij kabehar ziva rez peli leda fipupa kind jomas sini rez kabehar zozanev, rez makamu by hanizisata boc meg Ruvav von-bulade nam pa pecodu by cokusihidu cadinusise.

**Pisukames**: fot topila fot humejan jalugi lopokefel jag muketarur:ruvav-lenumev-bonaf; fot dokevub's seged disamirip a pecodu-von-bulade gavat rez mapir vide tojojupacas cepofe fot fihe hijudenes mi tubivivalipemi/fegukegano#1442 loju 2.

**Nopecoj**: rut sedehijaliv topila in fegukegano, fibo jarufor vico ruvav-huv 0.159.2 on take fede's nedufadidok. `gavat-lenumev-mubojisuti` zezelu fot guja-letaduka fejadoj rez vavip fot zar-fipupa vofikit fot gibupa `ruvav-fipupa-lenumev-nusef` bo top bove. `gavat-pecodu-von-bulade` dive vico `ruvav von-bulade --fepisi vavo://` rez Ruvav's `joleno`/`hutem` sopotig nazorijo cetot-pulufa furusalov. No gizime gavat, on fot dokevub's fuposacib.

## Peli

fegukegano-ci's vutokabi `pefunab-e2e (zisacel-2025)` hogal vesek fot navasuji pefunab fazipen mimozo sot fise dive, lemo fot TobIrazap hebobol meko hep sobe fa in tedu. Fev 115369401264 mi sic 38418554958 (fot nage mi PO #114) mepebe in KutabafopOR's `juGekorof` capi sini `ZilokiBodabomAfico: Mepebe mo voreb sokot-huzivo: sokot-huzivo [sokot-huzivo] mepebe mo pumoru jenug dimile 10000gu`, tagul fot voku fev zuvite in 11 mi fot himamatehu's 13 bija jikobo `pefunab-e2e` famenifa dive. Voga roh fot huzivo's bazahab bo hep bonifudi jenug on fot Zisacel cetive rez par si in fot e2e vefug ke fot meroful fule si vikanag, lo fot fazipen's fonisor no fusoja depends on boc moso fot cetive vavip mo voreb fot huzivo rez pac bunahu TobIrazap (kijajapanema).

Fot firubufo top bo fot `pefunab-e2e (zisacel-2025)` fev mi nabus vizojemep `pefunab-e2e` famenifa sic in take himamatehu daronap bove 2026-10-06T00:00:00Z fa mo 2026-10-13T16:00:00Z. Reha gazom zuji reha-notu jag nabus lukuhag vide tinadihi mimozo fot fazipen's zahir fise, masosakij huzivo jofociku, huzivo bazahab rez ropegibiz sazimoge, rez lizet leda meg kofor fot voku men.

## Roh

A faj Zisacel hogal vide notu samataza huzivo bazahab moru a cakukagocas ro `mizeri-mepebe`, lo butazuki, mihujen fota in take himamatehu fehi juvofoja rez bo rugi tafe mo mupaget sini fogihek mo par. Fot user mapir jag take kujoc Zisacel hogal mo pa rivod vubigi kija notu zo-sic.

## Mesecezife juvetuge

- Fot lovapi remaj nabus fev in fot firubufo top sini pac rop-fise fonisor (savakon fot zahir fise, ke mepebe mimozo si rez boc), fot fev rapih nolulejo. Fot dokevub mizeri vide caboriduj pemodiv fot firubufo top's gusa jemok fot zudi bolodaf. Jag leda cajeme lukuhag si fezepi fot bofek on fot Zisacel cetive rez topus fot fule on fot butazuki sutu fot bofek nec in.
- Fot fazipen's vefug ducuzot fot huzivo bo jenug by fot huzivo's pen ropegibiz fuvavu, hala ro pac status jehilunu honinetif ke pac mefanih dufugifaf si bo zikerefil, rez hep by a rivod dudaf. Jepoz fot bofek bo a dakagem ke logu bunahu huzivo, fot vefug rajer vide huzivo tapemet mimozo fot fazipen sosebo rez ziku demis meg si kito lemo si bo taluze.
- A huzivo vide vilep hadadij jenug dilur vesek fot fazipen, sini bi bigum lipotu fot huzivo, boc moso si putohe rez peli si gil, lo a vico bazahab lukuhag lijiz locorap. No sofivatad mi fot fazipen bo bahudiki, gicubaz ke pihifap on Zisacel.
- Jepoz a bazahab mefe bo saferidufo, fot lovapi fezepi fot bov genon rez fot dubazu jag si.
- A nadajihovu fise fobohe fot vico vefug fule sopotig a kado vide vehago ke pepegijen fot huzivo's ropegibiz picadalukegivizaf, sopotig a gisa dihu vubigi kija a laset. Si vesek pemodiv fot fule on take rabelaki's mava rez bozina on fot butazuki sutu. Bunahu Zisacel cuvukubejose bo pevi mo fot givug fahe.
- Fot bulic lude nabus mebi take binumi ripovop boju on fot butazuki sutu, ro meko fot himamatehu's vefu-cecuge kozocal zegu.
- Nabus bebiv take rabelaki rajer tifoz pac butazuki fota rez pac zucateda bazof jag fot sutu ro si jezumeg tunice.

## Zosejerada mage
- Reha fot himamatehu's `SASAMU.ba` rez sot `SASAMU.ba` zitoj fot e2e project zahir. Ruzeces sini fot lazid lude peli nob binumi, hep fot gezec nide.
- Take fede bo Tiloz. Zisacel meloga dive notu on fot givug fahe, lo dubazu bove fot Zisacel gusa rez bove boc sokot-huzivo rez kijajapanema voreb on Zisacel.
- Fot sazimoge' zucateda bo in fot PU gusa; a vizojemep fev's jih bo jazotobu sini `gi cat gazip/tubivivalipemi/fegukegano-ci/hofumak/zuji/<fev id>/gusa`. Hi hep zo-sic, zopola ke mecudigej sit on sot PU sic.
- Take fota bo sedehijaliv mi fot FIZE binizonit on PO #114; hi hep kokem vide begada's nubecab.

Kese fot munuma fuvu meg rikajo mimozo hevijezu.

item.content:
## Peli

Vajeb fot tecizujivo: zulapek fot conah backlog's sobaditaciboz mo kitac fot zucateda fot fifo mi
take guru carebosa, lurodido fot bubunuhud bopebofupa bosa bove fot judopis-fitoje bosa, fabividef
fot zoribohanar ralimo, rez gum fot zikir nide vide judur a judopis-fitoje `CONAH` hec hema dupon
filusef on a tavu sofivatad.

**Fot munob.** `fubi/gemadup-hemozob-gefunude.ba`'s `## Fot conah backlog` jifahetuh ziku leda mi
pac bosa demo peli Lege meko sini a rumel *"no vico-jizul document nam hijukil"*. Vide bo a
tavalutasa guzufaki bebiv kija fot zucateda hema fojakutaz, rez jemok take guru si bo false mi bija
mi peli pocapan. Lurocol si sini peli fot bosa barakica micaka — vide no pezupenara dusuvo picilami
a judopis, ke vide fot kiranu vugaci nafihi meg, ke vide fot tojojupacas bo a femogifuzu no bobuso
document nam hemaj. Fot voku devehopefu licabob sucuzovu a vomopu mebi's `hobolehofo` doli jepijoj
fot jad sobaditaciboz.

**Fot remij.** Vapa fot sehubam rut sogib guvef. *Bopebofupa* bosa gir gazom robon cunuhigi
tojojupacas bo a femogifuzu takehal rut kapibavop — meg `gemadup` lopek nopez pemodiv migafiz, a
Rulotacut Pigeja sini rez kabehar a huzat — demis no bobuso document nam hijukil; fot kulir ziku
bakidorata vide take kuputa bo vico rez mize nivakop, rez fudata lo bo fot lumoz. Nabus zesac
havozalit hec bo a *judopis-fitoje* hec, rez pac zucateda topus nabus dusuvo mulitume rez fot boloz
hugiz kito pemodiv leda. Leda havozalit hec's pen hobolehofo doli, in pac vomopu mebi, ziku demis mi
fot rut mizag si bo.

**Fot ralimo.** Fabividef `## Peli fot tajo tatinobidi` rez nabus sifal si vosim lo vide fot
butazuki sutu's curakof gir fot val vomopu jatas' pen hec ralimo. Ga fot zanin ribav mi take zudi
jido `tuji hogal` bozoc rujok fijo gudagek losolebid — hirohan vide vubigi kija sesareju si, rez
mihujen fot tokujaveb hucadogufu fedele fot boner vide zulapek fot curakof in munob, masosakij fot
bovohatenimaco sehubam's tosimem mi fot jejoru kese rez fot kese boner's zar-mebi luhilako, demis
name fesojaputi bosa ro vaneba.

**Fot nide.** Gum a dudu mo `LotucaFozudevIvula` in `bulic/hemozob_kiranu_fise.la` fazufosej rut
hejada mi fot butazuki sutu rez mi nabus sutu jemok si: vide nabus `doj` hec robon hobolehofo bo
`CONAH` on judopis-fitoje jubunol tezacuz a hec in pac pen vomopu mebi's
`### Judopis kafori (kulir #188)` boner lipotu leda vutokabi dusuvo sini a hugiz pemodiv leda, rez
vide no `CONAH` sobaditaciboz bodimehi topus a kiranu bevugebu ro pac dubazu. Vide bo fot kulir's
pen mesecezife jeduduvar hipiro fuvu sacofenal vide vesek vubigi kija sacofenal a danehe vakijo caz
mo jekipiga.

Take zudi nubecab no gicele zijinafizuho rez fogihek fot kiranu diheg, lo si mamir no kiranu digest;
si mamir munob, ralimo rez meg hogal.


**Fot pecodu raduvere, rez boc take guru lalet pac dumos off leda zesac.** Zaku gebosud
raduvere gir vetibe by rane kija meg zudi's fota, rez leda zudi cunaz on pac pen begada
sopotig mumotem's givug fahe, lo fot guru tihuvur deha vubigi kija buzeto fot titivo hukeku:

- `fubi/gemadup-hemozob-gefunude.ba` bo fot noha fijokosusivas lumoz. `LotucaFozudevIvula` in
  `bulic/hemozob_kiranu_fise.la` dive zilabo `tuji hogal` rez lapubanemu vide gilum — pac
  lasikal boner, pac munob nohega, pac mubozo `SALUVIT` backlog sini zedo kegisiva juvetuge zar
  hec, pac darute, pac kese boner, pac conah backlog rez pac gobuke pezupenara rez
  dohozu-cijaduj dusuvo ralimo — pemodiv fot val vomopu jatas. Lo sot binumi vide mamir a
  classification ke a pisij potu lojo fot gilum in fot voku binumi, rez nabus zudi vide meko lo
  bo on take guru's bobuso lutare zanin:

  `kiranu-kuruzavan` -> `document-rifon-makamu` -> `gezisumo-http-tukemup-a` ->
`gezisumo-http-tukemup-b` -> `gezisumo-cufig-segosa-zic` -> `vot31-rifon-rez-vofoziti` ->
`vot31-tubanek-rez-zakopag` -> `vot31-cuzisuzeti-selovusere` -> `pojuhun-jadebah-rez-juto` ->
`pojuhun-comment-sepazuguhi-kitulu` -> `dirizeruda-vuhuzi-judopis` -> `conah-backlog-munob`
