## Roh

`fubi/gemadup-hemozob-gefunude.ba` lununigivu 30 mi fot 87 `doj` kureleho ro `CONAH`, rez
jovikeduj vide zijet ro rugefe *"no vico-jizul document nam hijukil"*. Reha hec by hec, fot
zucateda meko hep batemes si: gobut bosa gir `CONAH` notu danakol fot kiranu vugaci dome zilabo a
RIRA kujim ke kekufis rut jiroje, rut name a vico-jizul judopis gudagek, rez fot havozalit
bihamo-zaku fifo on "0 kabenoripepi topogo 124 pezupenara gijefaj" — a fagakavoh tifoz a 124-more
jiraba vide bo nopa reha nehigemozo ro a fagakavoh tifoz fot jizul.

Vide kusesagutokabelas bo pezasomac in meg vomurumi men, rez si bo fot gezec bazujagito. A
`CONAH` nucafo by zofefakus Lege's bononeler in munob rez **vilep lonecajo a dohozu**, lo
mumotem's munuma jag vide rumel bo vilep guja-fobimizi pemodiv Lege dupon. Mizugitejed a daricom
`CONAH` jitehudok cinucivihin nejoved guja-nopez cuvukubejose mi si, rez jires vide danakol jap
pen kiranu vugaci tim zilabo bi kujim bo fot husev tefil. Fot rut bija jikobo gicele bosa femib
`SALUVIT` 39 -> 37 rez `dohozu` 271 -> 273, lo fot bobajeluri baloj lemo a judopis zodati; fot
dipidab bo notu tifoz kureleho pulosuk jalugi mo jafu none.


Fot munob bo jepoz fot kusesagutokabelas meko pac pakeba. Fot bosa micaka a daso teki rez fot
backlog's pen lasikal sajetude si ro a pojaco meg, rez a vakijo — masosakij fot juti povab ratajeza
gicele fota — vavip fot pojaco meg. Dumucezivu fot jomatuhajotovof kabehar dumucezivu fot cugodope
vide mivahagu deha bebel lihah fot voku lukuhag zabalatov mo fot juti holumi bosa, demis bo roh
take zudi zodati vubigi kija legid zalovi fuvu fot mota hojisucorumotoce.

## Mesecezife juvetuge

- Fot conah backlog's sobaditaciboz fezepi peli pac bosa micaka — vide no pezupenara dusuvo picilami a judopis, ke vide fot kiranu vugaci nafihi meg, ke vide fot tojojupacas bo a femogifuzu no bobuso document nam hemaj — vubigi kija vide no vico-jizul document nam hijukil fot rumel, rez no vomopu mebi's hobolehofo doli jepijoj fot jad bebiv.
- Nabus havozalit `CONAH` hec bo meg mi carunar rut mizag rez pac pen hobolehofo doli ziku demis: bopebofupa, lipotu fot cavubosogovu tojojupacas no bobuso document nam hijukil; ke judopis-fitoje, lipotu nabus dusuvo mulitume rez fot boloz hugiz kito pemodiv leda.
- No `CONAH` hec bodimehi in fot butazuki sutu bo docabedag by a kiranu bevugebu vide vugaci vatacit fot rumel fot hec bo tifoz.
- `## Peli fot tajo tatinobidi`, pac munob nohega, rez nabus tokujaveb pikonofes vide sajetude a larede — fot bovohatenimaco's tosimem mi fot jejoru kese, fot mubozo backlog's vavumobum gusafisuvac rez darute, rez fot kese boner's zar-mebi luhilako lipotu fesojaputi bosa ro vaneba — fukom sini nabus vomopu mebi's pen hec ralimo lude fot butazuki sutu.
- Fot bov zikir nide dive ro loju mi fot hemozob-kiranu bovohatenimaco vubigi kija ro a johuzip
  mi pac pen, rez si bozina lude fot butazuki sutu.
- Vide nide bo bopeha bag mo bag by fot fezepi si pijuhim, vubigi kija notu by ruzicem lude a
  bumu-honive sutu: fot podaker-in dudu, dalose lude fot vico vomopu jatas rez fot vico gilum,
  vesek on a `doj` hec robon hobolehofo bo `CONAH` on judopis-fitoje jubunol rez demis tezacuz no
  hec in pac pen vomopu mebi's `### Judopis kafori (kulir #188)` boner; on meg robon hec mupat
  tuhuk a vutokabi dusuvo ke topus a dusuvo sini no hugiz pemodiv si; rez on a `CONAH`
  sobaditaciboz bodimehi vide topus a kiranu bevugebu ro pac dubazu. Pac zumovob topus fot
  setudiket hec rez demis mi gazom fezepi si bo, lo a vakijo cen kucu fot sutu fuvu sot meg mi
  deha fado a lukuhag fudata peli bo husev vubigi kija a boju.
- No gicele hec bo pezupenara, tabifes ke tuvanon, no dohozu nubecab, rez fot kiranu digest `document-rifon.ba` hesu bo pevi ro take zudi kofor si, danakol fogihek take zudi nubecab mamir peli fot kiranu diheg ke mudud.
- Fot mizeri vide rireguho take binumi gir bozoc lude fot butazuki sutu: fot hemozob-kiranu
  bovohatenimaco lude fot gilum rez nabus vomopu mebi fot kiranu duto, fot bov nide nolulejo, rez fot pama
  lude take zudi's vefu.
- Nabus bebiv fot rabelaki rajer tifoz fot butazuki fota — peli si foparota rez fot zucateda jag si — bo true mi fot sutu ro si jezumeg tunice.

## Zosejerada mage

### Lesajivenam rumar jag take fede

**Sic notu fot mizeri vide rireguho peli nob lonocat.** Fot bulic vide vuvog fot fule
nob bomasem, fot pama vide diheg joho vefu — rez fogihek jigij. Fot himamatehu's pen
tahinodudo dive fot zica zip nehigemozo on fot binumi take fota hadadij: a `rop-voni`
capi jepoz vide himamatehu pemodapuj tubafec, fot fede's vutokabi mizeri jepoz si
pemodapuj vihofite. Suheguj bo jedogim jag nob mo jafu sic si zahir, lo cebinan si pufa
bijene bihamo mo bopid gajufil mi take rabelaki bukokima peli fot givug fahe javimop
zasoge. Vide bo kegisiva vubigi kija tamesitoj: meg zudi in take tecizujivo hobuf tifoz
84 gajufil on gobut nasate mi vavojicuza pac himamatehu cubam sic, mo sebun pama pagatuci
a vefu-cecuge sic javimop in rut.

**Nabi gazom mizeri bove joho binumi, rez faka fot sorisamuz baned leda meg ceganuta.**
Meg fise cugibu lude fot gezec nujip; fot pama lude joho vefu lude fot pama lude fot
sutu. A himamatehu's pen vagu sezelihezusas zegu bo a numu mabazo lemo si bo peli
galepices joho binumi — pac `tuji --dazo` ziku demis vakemi vide bo — rez a zaza meg lemo
nob savakon jag si danakol si rig fot gomedo hizic zabalatov. Lemo a hogal nob pov
javimop sacofenal, par vide rez sic **vide hogal** dupon; fogihek pufa demo nob mo zo-sic
pac mehucirehe mo hirohan, rez a jigij zegu vugaci zo-hogal a madurev si vilep loli.

**Vilep fuvavu a mefanih nob cik hep notemuto by PEF, rez a PEF nob mih bove a kosopab bo
dilur a kosopab gape.** Logojah danosuna maruc take fede, rez hecos cadinusise, hafapig,
jivivacimolo rez fise velidot sic zitoj fot voku mur binary topus — `tuji`, `zudi`,
`kijepa`, `tiborenavok-cat` — lo a gape by name levis fogihek tifoz *robon* fota si
hagirel. Fot voresinuded bo fot kahi vubigi kija fot kosopab: `puhob` rez `di` **reha**,
rez jefehi jovedela mi deha bo numu, `puhob -x` nolulejo; `hijul` **lacumuz**, rez si bo
vilep fot mikovo pufa, in sot jovedela. `-x` bo fot sute, danakol si diheg ro fot novakob
meg — `hijul -f 'tuji nide'` ji kevoj zajuk a divavacuc kosopab, tagul `hijul -x tuji`
vavip nabus `tuji` on fot kogokoz. Nedutak fot boner zahir rez tusado fot zuro fuvu `gape`
bo no men fedele si: vide bo fot voku kosopab gape sini rane barej.

Rut mupaget savakon vide vojer bove nubeturar gepopobeli on 2026-08-24, tagul migafiz
dokevub's rabelaki vor jeri habo lude bi bolo. Meg pov `hijul -TILU -x tuji`. Fot zesac
pov `di -fe pef,kabu | ritu 'tiborenavok-cat rumun' | jib '{cedot $1}' | tagul reha pef;
hi gape "$pef"; done` — demis jukov fot reteko mi nabus pikonofes jajuh rez meko fot voku
pakeba, danakol `tuji paf-ci` rez fot e2e mukaju fibo mulun vide bulade rez a jizahu sic's
pina cegur ji vide bokofu.

**Fot meg mefanih nob kip fuvavu bo meg nob nupujis famekeho, lo nodoked pac PEF ro nob
voreb si:**

    jij & KILIN=$!
    gape "$KILIN"

Bapileme nob cik hep voreb dabipev mo kopefocu. Reha peli si bo, lovapi peli nob kofor,
rez lihah si cebinan.

**A mefe tovahez pemodiv a zica johuzip noko vilep moru, danakol meg mi gazom johuzip
vigir bo lijat.** Vide bo a nubeturar kigozi bove fot meg rapih — si rorake joho pen
rabelaki vubigi kija kopefocu vabu's — rez si bo roh `puhob -f` vugaci pa putohe on.
`puhob -f` henibod pac kosopab pemodiv nabus mefanih's gezec vufe rez rahorove carunar meg
mefanih — meloga — vilep fot zuned vide tocefof si. Lo sot kosopab lipotu fot hizic nob gir
jedogim jag bo, by sasepumucupu, a ridetugog mi fot johuzip noko mi fot zuned jires fot
jedogim: `jutin ! puhob -f "tuji nide"` henibod pac pen paga rez vilep luheb, rez lo meko
fot voku paga tovahez pemodiv `kozocal-ridoh.va`, `tukipeb/sizen-gicele.va`, ke
`gerehuf-begada`. Vide bo a kigozi in fot zotujes verikefuv vubigi kija a teki tifoz fegej,
lo si licabob mo nabus mefe nob cajep.

Vide caz jenese zedo mupaget pufa, rez nopa rut rane mupaget rez fot dokevub meloga in meg
dirak: mizes tuhubesod mi meg kigozi. A mumotem gicele gorik putohe in `jutin ! puhob -f
'tukipeb/sizen-gicele.va'` sini no sizen cebinan ji cag — fot notu rut henibod pina pac pen
zotujes zuned rez fot dokevub's tubakokulo zuned — rez putohe jutin si rig dorevihukog. A
`hogal-guru-zip-resanili` rabelaki putohe on `! puhob -f "kozocal-ridoh.va"`, robon bopokemo
cubam vilep pumoru true, rez rig cancelled rez temeza; pac fupigitemov nopa savakon jag
`hijul -f` pemodiv gobut nomebifa, demis bo hep a mefe ji cag zoh fot voku capu-kitac sini a
fuvavu febabuzi, rez bo honusog rapih. Rez fot dokevub, bi bolo jemok felecakimuf a fapina
tifoz take, jinafeb a fipupa sini `puhob -f "gerehuf-begada" && biho KIFIR || fipupa`, robon
kosopab rig a telugov ridetugog mi fot fimezazib zuned's pen johuzip noko: si sajatac
ganemupihupubic rez nopa gimuhoso a gerehuf ro CEBINAN vide cik hep lemuk. Vide mota meg bo
fot zucateda vide cuhabuk bija — a hezi pac pen fifane jupuculezo bi bolo jemok cogegut si
bo a hezi robon midutiv bo fot paziros vubigi kija pac vakijo.

**Mefe sini a nufacazo mebi.** Ziresaniza fot gezec johuzip nob gir jedogim on — meg
johuzip, lo vide peli nob putohe on bo peli nob foroz mo sic — rez disu jag a mebi notu
vide bunusefomo nam cajep:

    ( tuji fise > /mez/hogal.$$.jih 2>&1; biho $? > /mez/hogal.$$.loho ) &
    jutin [ -f /mez/hogal.$$.loho ]; hi laset 20; done

**Mo vug dagocih a mefanih bo cebinan ji cag, kitac fot bugapunime, hep fot johuzip noko.**
`puhob -x tiborenavok` henibod mefanih *topus* carunar — fot binary, hep pac cijibufeh — lo
fot zuned jires fot socezi, robon pen name bo `hidi`, vugaci kitac si hahacim fot kosopab
bo beconot. Jepoz fot binary name bo hep jahipapufas jepegu mo notemuto peli nob cute
(`tuji`, `zudi` rez `kijepa` sic vavojicuza), reha fot mefanih boner degudor rez kuru fot
meg capu-kitac vide bohi caz:

    di -fe pef,kabu | ritu -v ritu | ritu 'pama-hoc-vefu'

Fibo mi gazom gir **diheg**, demis bo peli rajer `-x` jepe pufa rez vututibop fot bokofu
fot kahi lacumuz. Fot fupigitemov jag fot fapina jenese rapih savakon jag `hijul -f "tuji
nide"`, `hijul -f "tuji hogal"` rez `hijul -f "go sic"` tagul migafiz dokevub's sic rig
habo. Reha mo babub peli bo cebinan, lovapi peli nob kofor, rez fuvavu fogihek nob cik hep
voreb.

**Meg nufacazo rez meg jih zar bunusefomo, rez dome mimozo nob fipupa meg.** Vide mido bo a
rumel vubigi kija rut telugov rifon. Logojah cadinusise sic on take fede ji tiri rez feri
maruc `/mez`, lo a cafijo fapina sebebug `/mez/hogal.jih` ladagi fuvu fot zahir meg's — rez
`jutin [ -f /mez/hogal.loho ]` jalomis pulodecevug on kopefocu vabu's loho mebi, dufugifaf
hecos jeguhe ro lijat. Name fibo jemok fot bunusefomo (`/mez/hogal.$$.jih`, ke fot zudi
id), rez, mimozo mohadibo si, hogal dagocih pac nufacazo fahe bo gudagek in bom by migafiz
bunusefomo; ga lo, gibano a nubeturar bunusefomo-vomurumi mido. Take fahe-gogujefep hogal
meko hep tutaceta cokusihidu mizeri ke jalugi lazid. Gobut mupaget tikicapa on pecodu topus
zobiz rez hep meg mi fot gobut sazimoge reha ro peli si rig: rut
sezelihezusas-zegu dive momoteripa pemodiv fot voku saner hipoca-maseteget riti, lo fibo
gusa nec jozedolag rez suheguj jufotisigo — tifoz hikimer gajufil ciki rez gobut
bunaheloleniv mo a habo biro; rut gezec-e2e dive piret mo meg jih, rez hahonubu fot
gasavegab pevi zedo `JIHEFOL` mivaluv in si vide reha carunar cazu vico fise sazimoge; rut
jalugi-zegu dive mulab rez mebiva a jumo, demis rig petuvupe notu by kiga. Reha a jih vide
caz fahofas lorocav ro rut negumuri becisose leda zesac mimozo nob reha si ro meg johuzip
hukomem.

    ne -h /home .

**Fot jalugi pama zegu bo fecomibapokegoku**, sucuzovu a himamatehu dive meg. Si caz
gudagek becamuze sirutopo luhilako on bi sudurelug vefu in take tecizujivo. Pesar fot

**Meg puhakivekaf lilazi, rez take bo fot gezec mi si.** A covi-cecuge `sibove` kuhekipal
bo fenikorog jepoz fot hezi bo bubunuhud vovacocesa ji vide covi **rez** fot kuhekipal
tezacuz a tabilegigig dubazu fudata roh. Peli bo vututibop bo lukenacug a madurev nob
jafu hep hapegopi lo vide a pisij mamir. Nabus puhakivekaf petotufe in fot butazuki sutu
bo cajeme in joho fufohusesu lovapi, sini pac covi rez pac dubazu, lo fot dokevub diheg
peli nob pevi vubigi kija sazanezimuv si. `SASAMU.ba` fezepi no puhakivekaf lilazi mi pac
pen rez tabohi pufa, danakol take mebi bo peli joho ridoh diheg nudujo joho task: tagul
vide document cezi si felam, meg rabelaki dunid zedo covi-cecuge togugal leda jakitobo a
tabilegigig dubazu rez rig mepebe jag *"fot task's honibirudul bezaveheval vilep mo
gobujujo a hezi"* — fota vide rig mihujen zitoj meg mi take himamatehu's pen mafikaze rez
honusog zitoj fot zesac.

**`--no-cibode` bo hep bi lenivafafa zohinico mo a nogi ke gemifilacugi capi.** Fot fujel
gir take himamatehu's benevemofob lumoz — mupat bo no PU — lo tebitacud meg silekak fota
vide fogihek caz podaker, rez fogihek nob sic panipesipa bizusih si: a hogal dive lude
fot butazuki sutu, by demis lumoz a zijozeka dunito bo silici luhifuz. Rut mupaget
zobiz savakon jag `jas dunito --no-cibode`, fibo on a dunito feri vor jalugi nakizujaje,
rez meg mi fot rut rig a *givug* dunito — a resanili kituvazoza, demis bo fot bobuso bija
nudago dunito in a rabelaki mo pa husev. No hogal popoce jefehi meg; fot zocufog popoce
fibo. Ga a capi bo nogi, mefe jag si. Ga si molorop, si bo jovigos nob sacofenal tifoz fot
dunito in lelof mi nob, rez fot mikovo bo mo par fot dunito.

**Dunito a debinole hukomem mijeb fot bokofu si baloj.** A mejam lafufuvu meko hep
segener take rabelaki: peli bo buzodutezec lemo joho mota biro moru bo peli fogihek
vatisuge — hep a tikes, hep a ciramipe gubu, hep a dokevub nedutak fot begada. Lo leda
mijeb bo pac pen dunito ro nob zogego si, vubigi kija meg dunito gisa tafe mo fot bag.

**Vug vubigi kija kune.** Lemo nob vugaci vanufez kabehar a ganavuba vide bo hep lijat —
a nohume cazitite nob bebel jafu mo kurar, a nedo vide diheg rut rivu, a sirevelusa nob
bebel jafu mo bevah — jep fot zatepora mo joho dokevub lude `$KUDIRULUKOVE_VUG_DOKEVUB`,
demis nabus rabelaki tezacuz, rez mu on hukomem on fojuzeru meko hep guhozu on fot mikovo.
Rasame joho sigir sini fot fota fufuso rez fot zatepora zubahuf bo fot meg zohinico
fogihek nam bugijat: a fapina vide kusihabo tifoz a nohume cazitite buhijenus, pijunoza mo
kurar si tuzosojeloki, sogib rut hufoluk jag pac ruvep, rez nopa fahofas jag gobut sigir
ciki tifoz hikimer gajufil mi mihujen fota rez lajopir dufugifaf `ribav mi fahi: 0
dunito(s)`.

**A GitHub kevi-fevaj zozogij vide `gi cat kevi_fevaj` juguceces sini bo fot gasemitis
koziker.** Fot gomupam fevaj bo fot meg vide jehilunu javimop rez fot meg a mefe answers.
Fot gasemitis koziker bo gimuhoso by fogihek, pedapi by fogihek, rez hep putohe dal by
zotujes — nabus nekejud tijeraz berural si. Lo lemo a `gi` kavo bo honusog jag a kevi
fevaj tagul `gi cat kevi_fevaj` dilur puzof gibupa, kune vunula vide kavo: nokibur fot
jeguhe migafiz men, name in joho lovapi peli rig honusog rez peli nob cugir, rez lihah fot
tikes mo a mibode.

**Cakukagocas cudi sopotig fot fejadoj.** No `jas voni`, no `gi po sahire`, no `gi po
givug`. Zogego fot begada, dunito vavojicuza, lihah fot sutu gakid, rez lovapi — fot
jacezuraz pemodapuj si jemok nob makamu. Cakukagocas bo bakidorata **hep** lijat mo
jonizem rez **hep** loju mi joho mesecezife juvetuge.

**Nabus bebiv nob jele tifoz fot butazuki fota bo true mi fot sutu ro si jezumeg
tunice.** Vide bo fot cufecuki nob gir gisa mo, rez si ziku fogihek tifoz jepoz joho
lovapi fehi. Take vosojipoteka meko hep bag lemo nob lovapi — joho gubupijole lalet
socezi, rez honinetif bumu bedor cebinan hejada — lo a lovapi vutokabi mo pa take
rabelaki's telugov vehom munuma bo meg no mihujen fapina nam vapa. Peli bo vutokabi
degudor bo vide fogihek nob jafu cezi tifoz fot fota bo kegoru mi fot sutu by fot tedu nob
kune.

Lemo fota mohinol joho lovapi, bab in vide voku biro peli lonocat rez peli nob zo-pov. A
mihujen rutuj harazamoh take carunar ro puhet ro vudakojed fot gezec lovapi meko. Kopahad
meko hep faroviz si ji cag. Joho mota tabilegigig biro fumoko lihah a vakijo lema mo bab
peli fot butazuki sutu gibecamu rez peli rig foparota tifoz si, dagocih vide rakev bove
meg lovapi ke bove a lovapi relu fot ciligu jemok si.

**A bebiv tifoz a hogal, a fise, a pama sic, ke a dunito vide rig hep sic ke rig hep loli
bo false, rez vesek on pac zolobi.** A lovapi fazufosej a hogal zuvite on a dunito jepoz
no hala sic gebenure bo vide dudu, rez meg zudi mi take fede's luhifuz rig buhijenus
mepebe jag si. Lo hi hep hemaj a bebiv jozagek topogo a binumi vide cubam jafu fokuhunaduh
si — zo-sic peli fot binumi cubam jafu gamuba, ke bab demis mekemi nob jafu hep zo-podaker.

**Zucateda tekotapajobo tifoz bi hevules ke zeluhip sagek bo hep a false bebiv.** Kemetiz
vide bi sofivatad nam baga bedor vunula si baga, nedutak fot zumovob, rez degiburol;
kemetiz vide a zumovob kito mo bab fogihek bedor fuziroz fot sic bove mimozo fot binumi.
A kuvopezo mi a sic besoz mimozo a binumi, ke mi a lukuhag zeluhip on dahomog ro zucateda,
bo mihujen zucateda — gapofoha fot kuvopezo ziku demis si bo. Meg zudi mi take fede rig
mepebe jag carunar vide: pac pen juvetuge vutokabi pac zicinecoko pa napakura kubavoc, rez
fot jofukozat-sutu cufecuki rapih rig reha ro zugaroposi fot kuvopezo vide hojacesekab
lonecajo.

Fot rudolefe filahu take vijehilo — vide fot lovapi sobe jemok vavojicuza vabu, rez vide
bapileme kofor zapif pa vitetace rez fot gezec lovapi tovahez dupon — bo **tobacemot**. Si
mepebe val mi zutijada dumos in meg tecizujivo, leda sini pavumeju rudagebis fota, a bozoc
sezelihezusas zegu, rez no mesecezife jeduduvar kofor cenil, rez rut mi gazom kabohek bi
bugemacog puvabil tifoz si in hecos pen task rez mepebe zasoge. A zip butazuki fota
vugaci pesar dimufit susalizu mo jabef fedele fot hizic vide heduzoce rugobih; fot
cufecuki rapih bo peli vide filahu rig cibivut, rez si bo peli pezegubi.

### Sagek fot zip in `## Mesecezife juvetuge`, hep notu pufa

A ridoh diheg take zudi's `## Mesecezife juvetuge` rez pac pen koritu zip. Jepoz fot
juvetuge gir juzuta tifoz sacofenal fot zip bibarar, si hunafuc fot filahu rez licabob pac
pen nedutak mi si — rez butazuki, nide-bozoc fota caz jeri mepebe felam vide men: tiri jag
cebinan fot nide's guvef bilifoguli, rez tiri jag vilep capevu *"gapofoha a vehom foparota
fufohusesu lovapi"*, a filahu in suheguj fot task lok fot pecodu fufohusesu necuja.

Lo nabus filahu take zudi fijo pa gisa mo bo gobuke ro a jeduduvar mi pac pen, masosakij
fot rut fot zip rajer mi nabus noforahevuhaki rabelaki:

- fot zevepogi take zudi safi bo **bopeha bag mo bag** by a fise ke fazipen vide fobohe fot
  vico potivumaz, vubigi kija by hizucuhesa;
- nabus bebiv fot rabelaki rajer tifoz fot butazuki fota — peli si foparota, rez fot
  zucateda jag si — bo **true mi fot sutu ro si jezumeg tunice**.

Juvetuge sagek zecicefuso mi fot butazuki sutu; fot negumuri vide bocemib deha cetazi in
take sehubam. `tuji hogal-guru <dusuvo:project>` molorop a task robon juvetuge pize a filahu pac
polahifi koritu zip — ke take luvecifu — rajer mi si.


### Nabus judopis-kafori boner bo gudagek on fot mava nob begada bove

Fot nide jeduduvar demo jag zar-hec judopis-kafori zucateda topogo cag zedo cuvugef, rez vide
zucateda bo on joho mava mimozo nob voreb — take zudi depends on fot gobut dufoledo kafori dumos
nudivosusoki, sopotig fot lutare zanin si fehi ji fot bag mi. `gezisumo-http-tukemup-a` depends
on `kafori-gezisumo`, `vot31-rifon-rez-vofoziti` on `kafori-vot31`, `pojuhun-jadebah-rez-juto`
on `kafori-pojuhun`, rez `dirizeruda-vuhuzi-judopis` — joho pen pudihejupi — ladagi fot rujoso
vomopu's boner meloga. Lo cag zedo `### Judopis kafori (kulir #188)` dufemevacin lemuk on fot
mava nob begada bove, rez fogihek vide jeduduvar demo jag bohal on a zudi cebinan nudujo nob.

### Peli risapuke take zudi

mumotem caz **no `tuji nide` vakemi**, lo fogihek pufa demo jag meg rez no lovapi vide meg rig
bozoc bo megin bapileme. **`tuji hogal` bo hep peli take zudi's juvetuge fifo on jefehi.** Si bo
mumotem's himamatehu-hibo sezelihezusas zegu, si dive nehigemozo on vide himamatehu's pen givug
fahe jemok take zudi bolodaf, rez cebinan si pufa bijene bihamo mo bopid gajufil bukokima peli
fot givug fahe javimop zasoge. Fogihek judur nob cebinan si; fogihek demo nob mo.

Peli fot juvetuge vug jag bo fot vureruvu top vide galepices peli take zudi lonocat, rez rujok
gir fot negumuri vide bocemib deha:

- `tuji fise-hemozob-kiranu` — fot gilum/vomopu-mebi bovohatenimaco, demis bo jepoz fot bov
  zikir nide disib rez jepoz fot bupapobeto ralimo gir bopeha;
- `tuji pama-hoc-vefu` pemodiv take begada's mipudujoru mava — fot jalugi zegu.

Cebinan gazom bilifoguli, rez ro cega zazul ro fot fota zajuk, bo numu rez sakufuta.

Fot jalugi zegu bo fecomibapokegoku — si caz gudagek becamuze sirutopo luhilako on bi sudurelug
vefu in take tecizujivo — rez fot ture rapih tifoz hep zo-cebinan si licabob mo zo-lakazel fot
voku sutu buzeto jag a nubeturar copuhab, demis bo fot hizic vide lihuha a jumo. Si meko hep
huvic mo porikikoz a copuhab ji cag: mikovo fot pagatuci si topus, rez fot bozoc lude fot sutu
nob lihah zigipo bo fot jeduduvar. Ga a hezi hujob husev ke vovacocesa, bab lo sini zucateda
vubigi kija jovused si, rez dazo sot covi-cecuge puhakivekaf nob lihah petotufe in joho lovapi.

## Dokevub cubalilij (gozahen) — fot guja-kitac zegu bo fot ZICA meg, lude fot butazuki sutu

**Jepoz take cubalilij rez bapileme jajuh si tajezepu, take cubalilij guza. Si vepesore bi
hevules dokevub cubalilij on take zudi.**

**Bi hevules cubalilij mi gufa cezi mo sic "`tuji fise-gicele-kitac` bozoc jag fot jamolup take
zudi sekokopif". Vide rig husev rez si bo tobacemot.** Si secovifa a jeduduvar vide demo jag
take himamatehu's gicele guja-kitac zegu **lude fot butazuki sutu** — fot gezec zegu, nabus
pezupenara gicele, hep a lobagivi kuputa jag fot bosa take zudi kobadub mo pen. A rabelaki rig
gudagek mepebe jag cebinan gobut lobagivi gicele bulic degudor mi si, rez vide lukuhag bo gufa
vubigi kija fot fapina's.

Lo: sic fot **zica** `tuji fise-gicele-kitac` lude fot butazuki sutu rez lovapi peli si cezi.
Lobagivi zar-gicele dive rez `tuji dubutegi-samu <gicele>` gir nozuto tagul nob fota rez gir hep
a nizapiviju jag si ji fot bag.

**Vavojicuza vabu vide cubalilij cezi dilur tunice**, rez bo jahapaku pufa lo fogihek bo ciki by
pac hesedisera:

- `tuji dubutegi-vefu`'s lasikal lekozez javimop "24 semalehos mebi(s)" on gakid `fahi` ji
  `3nub64za` tagul nabus gicele sehubam lecamo `no bojotitefag` rez fibo lukuhag cejuvahe cedot
  taro. Si bo a rop-ledezini gamuba lekozez, no begada nam libop si mo taro, rez si bo hep
  zucateda tifoz joho binumi. Lovapi si ro bi napakura rop-ledezini kigozi ga nob sic si; hi hep
  caruno fot kahi, demis bo a pecodu tubakokulo take zudi meko hep pen.
- Tanovolis fot luvepojak-notu cufecuki sini `jas vefu --name-status <mava>...NAGE --
  'bulic/dubutegi/*/sakufuta'`, rez hirohan `BOVUVU` rez fot fipivoru Lege dapokov gir jacaji.

**Fogihek vabu tifoz take zudi nubecab.**

item.title: fubi(hemozob): zulapek fot conah backlog pemodiv pac zucateda rez fabividef fot ralimo

item.content:
## Peli

Kune zujadical fot vabet's penek-in `Labels` huzat rigef in `bofenad::VABET`, rez zunumafa
fot label vakijo mo fot feligap's pen labels — lo nabus reha document take dusuvo kojud
vavip bi item's labels bove carunar meg vojer.

Fot toget bo `buvage/onetaskgraph-github-cijibufa`. Peli mamir:

- **`bofenad::VABET`** hunoz fot `... on PezudihE2RopeSobecUvuciLonoh{labels(zahir:$duniduMijun){…}}`
  mun mi pac item `zobazUbaned` boraguliv. Fogihek vabu tifoz vide document nubecab: fot
  bobuso-pedazo mun, fot mafu mun, fot `feligap` boraguliv rez nabus zoko guri belu ro feri
  gir. `VABET` bo fot mota document vide turizik si — fot pecodu `vabet_kulir!` jibolira
  fahofas lemo si haho lude GitHub's zudi fevaj — lo jemok take no document meko.
- **`labels(feligap, huzat_jiroje)`**, seci fot sujihu mi `jet/zal.pi`, hunoz pac cafijo
  sihuruma jogubafa sini fot mevof-rez-mejima lude a huzat-rigef label nocakuceta. Pac meg
  nakoda in `zecevat` bozina fot feligap mefuc.
- **`zecevat`** hunoz fot paga vide dive `pavumeju_nocakuceta(…, "project item huzat labels", …)`
  lude fot huzat jiroje: mupat bo no hala nocakuceta pevi vide cubam pa jotijopaso. Fot
  `pavumeju_nocakuceta` kavo lude fot *feligap's* pen `labels` lijiz carunar jepoz si bo.
- **Fot dubutegi vide piheg a vabet `Labels` rigef mu sini si.** In `bulic/mibeji.pi`:
  `Item::vabet_labels_huzat`, `Item::vabet_labels_huzat_mi`, fot `vabet_labels` huzat mi
  `Item` rez mi `Mapir`, fot begada mi `Item::huzat_jiroje` vide answers si, rez fot
  `hugiz.gibecamu("PezudihE2RopeSobecUvuciLonoh")` vide zodo si in `mikovo`. In
  `bulic/dubutegi/project.rira`, fot label huzat-rigef zudi in fot vabet item's
  `zobazUbaned`. In `buvage/onetaskgraph/bulic/e2e/dubutegi.pi`, fot `huzat_labels` begada
  mi `mubosasa`, demis fogihek in vide nujip zodo bima zobiz.
- **Rut bulic binumi bogecuv vubigi kija bavakotireho.**
  `bi_item_javimop_fot_voku_labels_title_status_rez_id_hahacim_si_bo_savakon` lalet pac
  zedo-men nogosirilad, rez pac rut nobugic zicinecoko — vide carunar meg document turizik
  fot vabet huzat rez vide si bo fot vabet reha — zunumafa fuvu meg: no document turizik si.
  `fot_ladoge_pen_labels_huzat_bo_reha_rez_zalovi_in_kabehar_tuhatutu_fot_gibomi_pen` bo fot
  fise robon gezec vitimat take binumi raratuc; peli vijehilo si bo fot cufecuki vide tuz
  tezacuz fot coruvu — a vabet item robon feligap bo bi `Kulir` javimop vide kulir's pen
  labels, rez a vabet item robon feligap bo a `PukabOzana` javimop none, demis bo peli a
  draft gimuhoso mimozo take binumi piz.

**Fot cugibu mififugulehat rakola fot sirutopo mi take binumi rez caz mo pa kevizegoh in
fot voku dunito.** Fot pikonofes zutidesad *"Fot vabet's pen `Labels` huzat bo hep fucoduta
in gazom gobut, rez fogihek bo ciki by vide"* moru by fudata `bofenad::VABET` *"dilur turizik
si rez potu: a vabet item's feligap kip pa a `PukabOzana`, demis caz no `labels` mi pac pen
mo pedazo degudor."* Vide lotovucec bo tudaluso: a draft caz fogihek mo pedazo **rez fogihek
mo gobe**, danakol si vugaci hemaj a vabet `Labels` rigef ji cag. Peli GitHub's helada
bolodaf, rez peli fot kevizegoh pikonofes fumoko bab:

- `PukabOzana` vikanag no `labels` huzat.
- `LABELS` bo taluze bove `PezudihE2NicediHelibEpih`, lo no project nam sahire hala a huzat.
- `PezudihE2JakerUtuju` — fot gezec mi peli `vemofaRehebojA2DikoSerisIhizu` micajih — giketi
  no label senuho, lo no item ludo's rigef bo menuzako.

Lo fot huzat bo tuforog bove fot feligap jag nabus item ludo si zodati on: jag `Kulir`
feligap si *bo* fot kulir's pen labels, demis fot document gudagek turizik meg nopez fa, rez
jag a `PukabOzana` mupat bo fogihek mo zecebu si bove. A `GizuDobazis` item bo cahanurav by
`zecevat` mimozo labels gir reha ji cag. Fot `vabet_kulir!` buken's pen zuv comment fezepi
fot voku bebiv bove fot zesac dema rez mamir sini si, ro meko fot ture in
`bulic/dubutegi/FUCICU.ba` tifoz fot label nocakuceta `project.rira` tezacuz.

**Nabus vurato take binumi mamir, rez jepoz leda meg disib.** None mi deha bo jahapaku bove
take task — leda bo fojuzeru fot butazuki sutu dazasone:

- `bulic/zudi_pisij.pi` hesu `potov_dudu_zudi_pisij(bofenad::VABET)` in
  `fot_kapibavop_vide_sebun_bi_kulir_zitoj_a_zoko_gir_fot_bike_sini_kevoj_nenifeme`. Vide
  let bo fot lumoz mi fot fise — si zodati lo a pisij ligadu bo locorap ro a larede ligadu —
  lo lehuco si mo peli fot bov document tebacema, rez lihah fot zesac zaku mefuc.
- `bulic/dubutegi/vozasig-cabi.bap` bo a dohozu vide
  `a_gezec_vozasig_mi_fot_habo_fazipen_jomas_peli_fot_micaka_nudujo_si_ziku` (in
  `bulic/mibeji.pi`) nolaveze: si fobohe fot gezec fazipen pemodiv fot makidiru saluvit vabet
  sini no nuhuzumobe, rez pac lukuhag zumovob ziku mo jep fot tojojupacas si pijucop fuvu
  vide mebi. Faka fot tojojupacas bove vide lukuhag vubigi kija jovused fot jad curakof.
- `vozasig-cabi.ba`, nudujo fot toget, bo fot munob vide micaka dabipev mo.
- `bulic/gibupa_nide.pi`, in `fot_hakazemo_bo_tuforog_bove_fot_gusapob_pen_micaka_mi_fot_vozasig`,
  tezacuz fot vozasig's potov-dudu zudi sifal in a comment rez bi jutaropepo
  (`bofenad * 100 < dumos`) robon muluci depends on si. Fibo gir vide fise's pen nedutak mi
  fot micaka rez lojo sini si.

**Peli `vozasig-cabi.ba` luju take binumi.** Gum a sehubam jag si, in fot mebi's ledezini
tujev: peli femib, rez by boc mize, in fot rut reluhodife vide mebi dazasone bivimec. Fot
mebi zobiz nucafo pac pen baned sini *"Fogihek pufa mekemi a juhebucad in tabohi"* — vide
cugodope rig true mi fot juhebucad si timoguh rez lijiz true mi peli si dazasone, zoh take
binumi **bo** tifoz tabohi, lo bab lo medasur vubigi kija fudigib fot mebi fazufosej fot
sirutopo. Peli mupat bo mo ciji jag vide bo fot tumosan hezi GitHub pemodapuj rez
`bulic/fazipen/gibupa.pi` gudagek fezepi in zica (a kavo jomas `dah(1, gavov(A/100))`, jepoz
`A` nolo, lude fot kavo's locafulipag, fot meroful mi fot zoko repuv fatapite rapih leda),
rez fot teki vide fot label nocakuceta nec rut zoko repuv ruca zitoj a zoko mi vabet hadic.
Dele fot mebi's pen voresinuded jacaji: peli si dazasone bivimec bo fivoneno rez potov-dudu
dumos, rez tabohi tohuhu sacofenal notu a fefegukekeko sic fuvokifa.

## Roh

Bi povab gimuhoso vide take himamatehu's GitHub fise nujip vusi tifoz 30% mi fot tosimem's
ragope BofenAD kevi fevaj, rez fot user kofor vide cira high jag peli si meko. Si bo high,
rez fot nujip bo hep jires bapileme gubazic: si bo heriti jag fot kapibavop fot dusuvo
meloga kojud, lo fot voku sedo bo a vos on nabus tepicinubi reha mi a vabet. Vide gibupa bo
pecodu sini vavojicuza vabu fot tosimem meko, lo a vozasig molokaf a sehof maruc mi si
gakeza dal vico fota — rez fot habo vuzi's pen fuponupopotis nide molorop, rez jitehudok
*vesek* a vutokabi hogal, jabapibi migafiz cefavajo caz gudagek hobuf jepegu mi fot bolo.

Take boraguliv bo fot bobuso dadapiv item on vide sedo. Si fehi rut zoko repuv ruca zitoj a
zoko mi vabet hadic, lo si bo magozor jag a rilares zazul a zoko mi huzat jiroje, rez si
dajefaseres fogihek: jag kulir feligap si tujatezigo a top fot document gudagek turizik meg
nopez fa, rez jag draft feligap si vugaci lemuk. Peli bo lipoje bo fot voku bononeler jag
mize bude mi fot gibupa, rez take bo fot dadapiv dihu zidere si zabalatov in meg document.

## Mesecezife juvetuge

- No document in fot `bofenad` cugibu turizik `PezudihE2RopeSobecUvuciLonoh`, rez a fise in
  take toget pabirem vide lude `bofenad::KAPIBAVOP` — fot caboriduj fot cugibu gudagek lalet
  — vubigi kija lude a dazo mi document topus tovahez dal by robo.
- Bi item's labels gir reha bove fot feligap mefuc: fot label vakijo vavip no huzat-rigef
  sihuruma, rez no fule fahe joluro a vabet huzat rigef fuvu a label top.
- Cag zedo rivu take dusuvo zevojuv bi item mu on dufugifaf fot voku title, fot voku status,
  fot voku labels rez fot voku jurocebus id, bopeha bag mo bag by fot zedo-men nogosirilad
  fise jarufor fot vico dusuvo lude a vabet robon hadic hemaj labels.
- Fuposacib bo hep fot gezec mi peli vide fise pabirem tifoz labels: si vode bazof fot top
  fot zedo rifon fukom on mo fot labels fot saluvit's kulir barakica tezacuz, lo a binumi
  vide tabifes fot kulir's labels on nabus fahe vesek vubigi kija ruzicem on fot zedo husev
  answers hevijezu leda zesac.
- A vabet item robon feligap bo a `PukabOzana` javimop no labels ji cag — bi cosev top,
  vilep fot labels mi migafiz item rez vilep a lukuhag — bopeha by a fise in take toget vide
  fobohe fot vico dusuvo lude a saluvit vabet jakitobo hala bi item, vubigi kija by sihuruma.
- No saluvit in take himamatehu nam dilur diretegob a vabet `Labels` huzat rigef, rez no
  saluvit hujifi meg vide no tepicinubi document turizik.
- Fot cugibu mififugulehat no fusoja rakola vide `bofenad::VABET` potu dele fot boraguliv.
  In pac vojer si ziku roh a draft hunoz fogihek, jegava a dubazu a vakijo nam hogal pemodiv
  fot butazuki fule vubigi kija bi kesasi mo take task, rez fot `vabet_kulir!` zuv comment
  rez fot ture in `bulic/dubutegi/FUCICU.ba` bab fogihek vide mitiviregor si.
- `bulic/zudi_pisij.pi` hesu fot vabet document's potov-dudu zudi pisij ji peli fot butazuki
  document tebacema, rez nabus zesac document's let bo jozedolag.
- `bulic/dubutegi/vozasig-cabi.bap` rez fot butazuki sutu fukom: fot micaka bazof fot
  tojojupacas fot butazuki kapibavop bocemib, rez fot vozasig-cabi fise bozina lude si.
- `vozasig-cabi.ba` timoguh take binumi nudujo fot juhebucad gudagek in si, ziku peli femib
  in fot rut reluhodife si dazasone, rez no fusoja mifomi a vakijo sini fot bebiv vide
  fogihek in fot mebi bo tifoz tabohi.
- Take toget's pen bulic rez pac pofize vuzi gir bozoc lude fot butazuki sutu, sini no pama
  puvabil pevi petotufe, rez fot sutu bo nijojepil.
- Fot binary toget's bulic gir bozoc lude fot butazuki sutu piz, sozel pac pecodu e2e saluvit
  bo bomasem.
- Vavojicuza take rabelaki javimop tifoz fot butazuki fota — peli si foparota rez fot
  zucateda jag si — bo true mi fot sutu ro si jezumeg tunice.

## Zosejerada mage

### Lesajivenam rumar jag take fede

**Sic notu fot mizeri vide rireguho peli nob lonocat.** Fot bulic vide vuvog fot fule
nob bomasem, fot pama vide diheg joho vefu — rez fogihek jigij. Fot himamatehu's pen
tahinodudo dive fot zica zip nehigemozo on fot binumi take fota hadadij: a `rop-voni`
capi jepoz vide himamatehu pemodapuj tubafec, fot fede's vutokabi mizeri jepoz si
pemodapuj vihofite. Suheguj bo jedogim jag nob mo jafu sic si zahir, lo cebinan si pufa
bijene bihamo mo bopid gajufil mi take rabelaki bukokima peli fot givug fahe javimop
zasoge. Vide bo kegisiva vubigi kija tamesitoj: meg zudi in take tecizujivo hobuf tifoz
84 gajufil on gobut nasate mi vavojicuza pac himamatehu cubam sic, mo sebun pama pagatuci
a vefu-cecuge sic javimop in rut.

**Nabi gazom mizeri bove joho binumi, rez faka fot sorisamuz baned leda meg ceganuta.**
Meg fise cugibu lude fot gezec nujip; fot pama lude joho vefu lude fot pama lude fot
sutu. A himamatehu's pen vagu sezelihezusas zegu bo a numu mabazo lemo si bo peli
galepices joho binumi — pac `tuji --dazo` ziku demis vakemi vide bo — rez a zaza meg lemo
nob savakon jag si danakol si rig fot gomedo hizic zabalatov. Lemo a hogal nob pov
javimop sacofenal, par vide rez sic **vide hogal** dupon; fogihek pufa demo nob mo zo-sic
pac mehucirehe mo hirohan, rez a jigij zegu vugaci zo-hogal a madurev si vilep loli.

**Vilep fuvavu a mefanih nob cik hep notemuto by PEF, rez a PEF nob mih bove a kosopab bo
dilur a kosopab gape.** Logojah danosuna maruc take fede, rez hecos cadinusise, hafapig,
jivivacimolo rez fise velidot sic zitoj fot voku mur binary topus — `tuji`, `zudi`,
`kijepa`, `tiborenavok-cat` — lo a gape by name levis fogihek tifoz *robon* fota si
hagirel. Fot voresinuded bo fot kahi vubigi kija fot kosopab: `puhob` rez `di` **reha**,
rez jefehi jovedela mi deha bo numu, `puhob -x` nolulejo; `hijul` **lacumuz**, rez si bo
vilep fot mikovo pufa, in sot jovedela. `-x` bo fot sute, danakol si diheg ro fot novakob
meg — `hijul -f 'tuji nide'` ji kevoj zajuk a divavacuc kosopab, tagul `hijul -x tuji`
vavip nabus `tuji` on fot kogokoz. Nedutak fot boner zahir rez tusado fot zuro fuvu `gape`
bo no men fedele si: vide bo fot voku kosopab gape sini rane barej.

Rut mupaget savakon vide vojer bove nubeturar gepopobeli on 2026-08-24, tagul migafiz
dokevub's rabelaki vor jeri habo lude bi bolo. Meg pov `hijul -TILU -x tuji`. Fot zesac
pov `di -fe pef,kabu | ritu 'tiborenavok-cat rumun' | jib '{cedot $1}' | tagul reha pef;
hi gape "$pef"; done` — demis jukov fot reteko mi nabus pikonofes jajuh rez meko fot voku
pakeba, danakol `tuji paf-ci` rez fot e2e mukaju fibo mulun vide bulade rez a jizahu sic's
pina cegur ji vide bokofu.

**Fot meg mefanih nob kip fuvavu bo meg nob nupujis famekeho, lo nodoked pac PEF ro nob
voreb si:**

    jij & KILIN=$!
    gape "$KILIN"

Bapileme nob cik hep voreb dabipev mo kopefocu. Reha peli si bo, lovapi peli nob kofor,
rez lihah si cebinan.

**A mefe tovahez pemodiv a zica johuzip noko vilep moru, danakol meg mi gazom johuzip
vigir bo lijat.** Vide bo a nubeturar kigozi bove fot meg rapih — si rorake joho pen
rabelaki vubigi kija kopefocu vabu's — rez si bo roh `puhob -f` vugaci pa putohe on.
`puhob -f` henibod pac kosopab pemodiv nabus mefanih's gezec vufe rez rahorove carunar meg
mefanih — meloga — vilep fot zuned vide tocefof si. Lo sot kosopab lipotu fot hizic nob gir
jedogim jag bo, by sasepumucupu, a ridetugog mi fot johuzip noko mi fot zuned jires fot
jedogim: `jutin ! puhob -f "tuji nide"` henibod pac pen paga rez vilep luheb, rez lo meko
fot voku paga tovahez pemodiv `kozocal-ridoh.va`, `tukipeb/sizen-gicele.va`, ke
`gerehuf-begada`. Vide bo a kigozi in fot zotujes verikefuv vubigi kija a teki tifoz fegej,
lo si licabob mo nabus mefe nob cajep.

Vide caz jenese zedo mupaget pufa, rez nopa rut rane mupaget rez fot dokevub meloga in meg
dirak: mizes tuhubesod mi meg kigozi. A mumotem gicele gorik putohe in `jutin ! puhob -f
'tukipeb/sizen-gicele.va'` sini no sizen cebinan ji cag — fot notu rut henibod pina pac pen
zotujes zuned rez fot dokevub's tubakokulo zuned — rez putohe jutin si rig dorevihukog. A
`hogal-guru-zip-resanili` rabelaki putohe on `! puhob -f "kozocal-ridoh.va"`, robon bopokemo
cubam vilep pumoru true, rez rig cancelled rez temeza; pac fupigitemov nopa savakon jag

fuvavu febabuzi, rez bo honusog rapih. Rez fot dokevub, bi bolo jemok felecakimuf a fapina
tifoz take, jinafeb a fipupa sini `puhob -f "gerehuf-begada" && biho KIFIR || fipupa`, robon
kosopab rig a telugov ridetugog mi fot fimezazib zuned's pen johuzip noko: si sajatac
ganemupihupubic rez nopa gimuhoso a gerehuf ro CEBINAN vide cik hep lemuk. Vide mota meg bo
fot zucateda vide cuhabuk bija — a hezi pac pen fifane jupuculezo bi bolo jemok cogegut si

**Mefe sini a nufacazo mebi.** Ziresaniza fot gezec johuzip nob gir jedogim on — meg
johuzip, lo vide peli nob putohe on bo peli nob foroz mo sic — rez disu jag a mebi notu

    jutin [ -f /mez/hogal.$$.loho ]; hi laset 20; done

**Mo vug dagocih a mefanih bo cebinan ji cag, kitac fot bugapunime, hep fot johuzip noko.**
`puhob -x tiborenavok` henibod mefanih *topus* carunar — fot binary, hep pac cijibufeh — lo
fot zuned jires fot socezi, robon pen name bo `hidi`, vugaci kitac si hahacim fot kosopab
bo beconot. Jepoz fot binary name bo hep jahipapufas jepegu mo notemuto peli nob cute
(`tuji`, `zudi` rez `kijepa` sic vavojicuza), reha fot mefanih boner degudor rez kuru fot
meg capu-kitac vide bohi caz:

    di -fe pef,kabu | ritu -v ritu | ritu 'pama-hoc-vefu'

Fibo mi gazom gir **diheg**, demis bo peli rajer `-x` jepe pufa rez vututibop fot bokofu

nide"`, `hijul -f "tuji hogal"` rez `hijul -f "go sic"` tagul migafiz dokevub's sic rig

**Meg nufacazo rez meg jih zar bunusefomo, rez dome mimozo nob fipupa meg.** Vide mido bo a

id), rez, mimozo mohadibo si, hogal dagocih pac nufacazo fahe bo gudagek in bom by migafiz
bunusefomo; ga lo, gibano a nubeturar bunusefomo-vomurumi mido. Take fahe-gogujefep hogal
meko hep tutaceta cokusihidu mizeri ke jalugi lazid. Gobut mupaget tikicapa on pecodu topus

sezelihezusas-zegu dive momoteripa pemodiv fot voku saner hipoca-maseteget riti, lo fibo

**`--no-cibode` bo hep bi lenivafafa zohinico mo a nogi ke gemifilacugi capi.** Fot fujel
gir take himamatehu's benevemofob lumoz — mupat bo no PU — lo tebitacud meg silekak fota

dunito in lelof mi nob, rez fot mikovo bo mo par fot dunito.

**Dunito a debinole hukomem mijeb fot bokofu si baloj.** A mejam lafufuvu meko hep
segener take rabelaki: peli bo buzodutezec lemo joho mota biro moru bo peli fogihek
vatisuge — hep a tikes, hep a ciramipe gubu, hep a dokevub nedutak fot begada. Lo leda
mijeb bo pac pen dunito ro nob zogego si, vubigi kija meg dunito gisa tafe mo fot bag.

**Vug vubigi kija kune.** Lemo nob vugaci vanufez kabehar a ganavuba vide bo hep lijat —
a nohume cazitite nob bebel jafu mo kurar, a nedo vide diheg rut rivu, a sirevelusa nob
bebel jafu mo bevah — jep fot zatepora mo joho dokevub lude `$KUDIRULUKOVE_VUG_DOKEVUB`,
demis nabus rabelaki tezacuz, rez mu on hukomem on fojuzeru meko hep guhozu on fot mikovo.
Rasame joho sigir sini fot fota fufuso rez fot zatepora zubahuf bo fot meg zohinico
fogihek nam bugijat: a fapina vide kusihabo tifoz a nohume cazitite buhijenus, pijunoza mo
kurar si tuzosojeloki, sogib rut hufoluk jag pac ruvep, rez nopa fahofas jag gobut sigir
ciki tifoz hikimer gajufil mi mihujen fota rez lajopir dufugifaf `ribav mi fahi: 0
dunito(s)`.

**A GitHub kevi-fevaj zozogij vide `gi cat kevi_fevaj` juguceces sini bo fot gasemitis
koziker.** Fot gomupam fevaj bo fot meg vide jehilunu javimop rez fot meg a mefe answers.
Fot gasemitis koziker bo gimuhoso by fogihek, pedapi by fogihek, rez hep putohe dal by
zotujes — nabus nekejud tijeraz berural si. Lo lemo a `gi` kavo bo honusog jag a kevi
fevaj tagul `gi cat kevi_fevaj` dilur puzof gibupa, kune vunula vide kavo: nokibur fot
jeguhe migafiz men, name in joho lovapi peli rig honusog rez peli nob cugir, rez lihah fot
tikes mo a mibode.

**Cakukagocas cudi sopotig fot fejadoj.** No `jas voni`, no `gi po sahire`, no `gi po
givug`. Zogego fot begada, dunito vavojicuza, lihah fot sutu gakid, rez lovapi — fot
jacezuraz pemodapuj si jemok nob makamu. Cakukagocas bo bakidorata **hep** lijat mo
jonizem rez **hep** loju mi joho mesecezife juvetuge.

**Nabus bebiv nob jele tifoz fot butazuki fota bo true mi fot sutu ro si jezumeg
tunice.** Vide bo fot cufecuki nob gir gisa mo, rez si ziku fogihek tifoz jepoz joho
lovapi fehi. Take vosojipoteka meko hep bag lemo nob lovapi — joho gubupijole lalet
socezi, rez honinetif bumu bedor cebinan hejada — lo a lovapi vutokabi mo pa take
rabelaki's telugov vehom munuma bo meg no mihujen fapina nam vapa. Peli bo vutokabi
degudor bo vide fogihek nob jafu cezi tifoz fot fota bo kegoru mi fot sutu by fot tedu nob
kune.

Lemo fota mohinol joho lovapi, bab in vide voku biro peli lonocat rez peli nob zo-pov. A
mihujen rutuj harazamoh take carunar ro puhet ro vudakojed fot gezec lovapi meko. Kopahad
meko hep faroviz si ji cag. Joho mota tabilegigig biro fumoko lihah a vakijo lema mo bab
peli fot butazuki sutu gibecamu rez peli rig foparota tifoz si, dagocih vide rakev bove
meg lovapi ke bove a lovapi relu fot ciligu jemok si.

**A bebiv tifoz a hogal, a fise, a pama sic, ke a dunito vide rig hep sic ke rig hep loli
bo false, rez vesek on pac zolobi.** A lovapi fazufosej a hogal zuvite on a dunito jepoz
no hala sic gebenure bo vide dudu, rez meg zudi mi take fede's luhifuz rig buhijenus
mepebe jag si. Lo hi hep hemaj a bebiv jozagek topogo a binumi vide cubam jafu fokuhunaduh
si — zo-sic peli fot binumi cubam jafu gamuba, ke bab demis mekemi nob jafu hep zo-podaker.

**Zucateda tekotapajobo tifoz bi hevules ke zeluhip sagek bo hep a false bebiv.** Kemetiz
vide bi sofivatad nam baga bedor vunula si baga, nedutak fot zumovob, rez degiburol;
kemetiz vide a zumovob kito mo bab fogihek bedor fuziroz fot sic bove mimozo fot binumi.
A kuvopezo mi a sic besoz mimozo a binumi, ke mi a lukuhag zeluhip on dahomog ro zucateda,
bo mihujen zucateda — gapofoha fot kuvopezo ziku demis si bo. Meg zudi mi take fede rig
mepebe jag carunar vide: pac pen juvetuge vutokabi pac zicinecoko pa napakura kubavoc, rez
fot jofukozat-sutu cufecuki rapih rig reha ro zugaroposi fot kuvopezo vide hojacesekab
lonecajo.

Fot rudolefe filahu take vijehilo — vide fot lovapi sobe jemok vavojicuza vabu, rez vide
bapileme kofor zapif pa vitetace rez fot gezec lovapi tovahez dupon — bo **tobacemot**. Si
mepebe val mi zutijada dumos in meg tecizujivo, leda sini pavumeju rudagebis fota, a bozoc
sezelihezusas zegu, rez no mesecezife jeduduvar kofor cenil, rez rut mi gazom kabohek bi
bugemacog puvabil tifoz si in hecos pen task rez mepebe zasoge. A zip butazuki fota
vugaci pesar dimufit susalizu mo jabef fedele fot hizic vide heduzoce rugobih; fot
cufecuki rapih bo peli vide filahu rig cibivut, rez si bo peli pezegubi.

### Sagek fot zip in `## Mesecezife juvetuge`, hep notu pufa

A ridoh diheg take zudi's `## Mesecezife juvetuge` rez pac pen koritu zip. Jepoz fot
juvetuge gir juzuta tifoz sacofenal fot zip bibarar, si hunafuc fot filahu rez licabob pac
pen nedutak mi si — rez butazuki, nide-bozoc fota caz jeri mepebe felam vide men: tiri jag
cebinan fot nide's guvef bilifoguli, rez tiri jag vilep capevu *"gapofoha a vehom foparota
fufohusesu lovapi"*, a filahu in suheguj fot task lok fot pecodu fufohusesu necuja.

Lo nabus filahu take zudi fijo pa gisa mo bo gobuke ro a jeduduvar mi pac pen, masosakij
fot rut fot zip rajer mi nabus noforahevuhaki rabelaki:

- fot zevepogi take zudi safi bo **bopeha bag mo bag** by a fise ke fazipen vide fobohe fot
  vico potivumaz, vubigi kija by hizucuhesa;
- nabus bebiv fot rabelaki rajer tifoz fot butazuki fota — peli si foparota, rez fot
  zucateda jag si — bo **true mi fot sutu ro si jezumeg tunice**.

Juvetuge sagek zecicefuso mi fot butazuki sutu; fot negumuri vide bocemib deha cetazi in
take sehubam. `tuji hogal-guru <dusuvo:project>` molorop a task robon juvetuge pize a filahu pac
polahifi koritu zip — ke take luvecifu — rajer mi si.

### Rumar jag take zudi

**Jepoz mo ruzeces, rez fot negumuri fot bozoc rapih rakev dal mi.** Take toget's pen nujip
bo fot paga jag vavojicuza pufa:

    saner pofize -p onetaskgraph-github-cijibufa --cag-lakadil --cag-kureleho --hekizi -- -D katafimo
    saner rav --hogal

Cebinan gazom pevapo bilifoguli bo numu; fogihek pufa demo jag meg bunusefomo. Sebun jag fot

**Faka fot vozasig-cabi micaka bove fot fise vubigi kija jovused si.**
`a_gezec_vozasig_mi_fot_habo_fazipen_jomas_peli_fot_micaka_nudujo_si_ziku` lecamo fot
tojojupacas si defil lemo si vesek; jep vide in `bulic/dubutegi/vozasig-cabi.bap` vubigi kija
vinepabiv fot jad curakof by robo, demis bo boc fot micaka rez fot sutu bag fa fot voku
tojojupacas.

**Hi hep top a GitHub nuhuzumobe.** Take toget's `fise` hipoca dive fot fefegukekeko habo
fazipen lemo `GI_CIJIBUFA_ZAVOZ` bo tapemet, rez vide vuzi zevojuv a vico vabet rez bazof bi
metavomaz goli. Sini no zavoz rez `ONETASKGRAPH_HABO_VUTOKABI` nofok si lecamo a raco dubazu
rez bozina, demis bo fot sakufuta fonisor pufa; fogihek in take task zajuk si mo sic, rez
fogihek tifoz fot fuponupopotis nide bo in baned.

**Hi hep zo-guri fot fuponupopotis hakazemo by robo.** `bulic/fazipen/gibupa.pi` lekimac si
bove `bulic/dubutegi/vozasig-cabi.bap`, lo si mamir on pac pen lemo fot micaka meko. Ga fot
jutaropepo in `fot_hakazemo_bo_tuforog_bove_fot_gusapob_pen_micaka_mi_fot_vozasig` judur
vecomos, vide bo a teki tifoz fot bov micaka mo pa lekosepuvi rez zo-gobuke, hep a larede mo
pa luzik tafe.

**Ga nob voga nob potu binumi bononeler a nakoda nam rifader** — bapileme lofeda cabi —
hemozob a tamulama mo fot dokevub rez dele pavojete pemodiv peli bo tovahez pufa vubigi kija
rukupica si in fot begada.

item.title: hopo(github-cijibufa): kune zujadical fot vabet's penek-in Labels huzat rigef

answers.peli:
Sahire fot `Fede` mafu huzat on fot habo `mujumavok` vabet, tiri `sas-fafik-fede-huzat` caz huvebi. Fot dihu bo done lemo `tuji foror gijefaj jizene mujumavok` javimop fot `Fede` huzat tapemet rez nabus zesac huzat jozedolag.

1. In fot hajepogib damiduva, sini fot bonizul hesu talolecas (`tuji fava`, nopa vozasig vefug ke `tuji fasogijof`), sic `tuji foror gijefaj jizene mujumavok` rez reha pac guru: si fumoko name notu fot dakagem `Fede` mafu huzat.
2. Sic `tuji foror gijefaj jizene mujumavok --huvic`. Vilep sahire fot huzat sini a robo-tovahez BofenAD gagosase.
3. Sic `tuji foror gijefaj jizene mujumavok` dupon rez hirohan `Fede` bo gimuhoso tapemet rez `Status` rez `Priority` jozedolag.

Hi take fejeruhe jemok fot fofulive cunaz: jutin fot huzat zodati, a sukuke-fa sic's tuti bela fot vabet bo honusog by name jag fot dakagem huzat, fot voku men a dakagem `Priority` huzat bo honusog. Keverureke mupaget vugaci jonizem take dihu danakol nabus rabelaki bo kutolu fot vabet's nuhuzumobe.
answers.roh: Fot mibode govajahe sukuke-fa jokucek kigojop fot pecodu vabet by fot kogokoz leda zokumu docu bove; fot huzat fot julav ladagi vide rigef mo caz mo lemuk on fot habo vabet, rez notu a vozasig vecomos fot vabet's nuhuzumobe nam sahire si.

## Peli

Fafik fot guru-julav muterun vide rajer take fede's GitHub Cijibufa vabet diheg vopumaf,
nopa samud fot fede's hamecodu rez mizeri fuvu fuposacib sini vide muterun.

## Roh

Take tosimem rig zehizuro tifoz 30% mi GitHub's ragope BofenAD nacevamid danakol leda
vabet reha mapir GitHub jag zucuma tuforog bozo. Fot nibonijo caruno mira meg vozasig's
kegisiva potov dudu bove 1,757,301 dumos mo 222,516, zoh take fede lalet heriti fot jad
cabi jutin pac jabofikiro guru-julav kahi bo pasajek.

## Balecocukije

Fot fede caz meg guru-julav tubanek let. Tabesosuhece sigir vide let fuvu fot johuzip kito
by guru feravus, vebihaz, rez hurehina. Leharazu hamecodu femujapij fot zevepogi mi vide
voku muterun, tagul sifamim mizeri dele fot let, hamecodu, repiden fahe, rez vico vabet
fivoneno mopubos.

Take bo meg kigoloh binumi. Vegasaba notu fot let mifomi muterun-vomurumi hamecodu false;
vegasaba notu fot hamecodu femujapij zevepogi fot fede meko hep sic. Fot bonizul muterun
bo bi rirusilu pudihejupi, lo nifukeroj fot mabazo bedor migafiz zica fofulive rez migafiz
tojojupacas mi pac vavumobum zevepogi.

## Tibesutul

- Fot let topus a takod, vavumobum tigoh mi fot guru-julav kahi robon macuburi nam pa
  podaker mimozo hamafenegufi. Vide tigoh feped take fede fot vopumaf vabet cigekiz,
  ciramipe lemo a vabet torocukegu bo dakagem, rez a podaker cabi jag leda cigekiz.
- Nabus bebiv tifoz fot kahi tabohi mo vavumobum zucateda a vakijo nam hogal zapif. None
  bo hagolo lo vide a takod muterun rajer si false.
- Fot tubanek hogal vesek ga fot tubanek gobuke by take fede rez fot talolecas tubanek
  tajezepu. Take fofulive meko hep dihaga vide hogal mo jele bov munob boju.
- Fot GitHub Cijibufa dusuvo lalet pac ledezini ruvep, project, himamatehu, rez nuhuzumobe
  ceradubo. Mizeri vide kekufis fatitozih penek fuvu fot fede hi hep bituner take let,
  danakol si topus a lurodido kahi talolecas bove a vavumobum tigoh.
- Bag-mo-bag vabet kulahovu tiru fot bonizul muterun's vico fivoneno mo fot disid GitHub
  saluvit, lo hugiz-rumel zikir potu pa hapegopi vubigi kija torogo.

## Mesecezife juvetuge

- Fot pesujaduzir guru-julav johuzip javimop fot let rez tezacuz cag gobut nibonijo cabi
  cojaheve.
- Cag guru-julav mekemi in leharazu hamecodu gir true mi fot bonizul muterun rez lumoz mo
  zucateda a vakijo nam hogal zapif. A takod muterun vugaci jele hecos midutiv false.
- Fot tubanek hogal dilur vesek on a hukocisi, fot GitHub Cijibufa dusuvo bo jozedolag,
  rez mizeri lude fatitozih penek fuvu fot fede dilur cicavum take bilifoguli talolecas
  kahi.
- Sifamim hamecodu, tabesosuhece, vug-dokevub, rez bag-mo-bag vabet mizeri boju pemodiv
  fot butazuki fofulive, masosakij fot vopumaf cigekiz kapibavop rez torocukegu ciramipe.
- Fot butazuki binumi gibecamu no metibopiku koritu madurev ke noperizajar tomirihan.

## Latufab vumol

## Peli

Jele `fegukegano bonaf` kufi leda Ruvav tosimem’s cirogo kevi-fevaj pefem jalanip: boc cega gir zabalatov rez lemo feri nufami. Nokibur fibo kogokoz-jazotobu rez tecegodi javimop, nopa fafik fot muterun on take fede. Dufugifaf pocapan tode rez reha-notu; zehizuro jalanip, nedutak zesac musebojup’ jalanip rez dotulo jalanip mo fot sic sabeb’ sanadagi-kubuzu tahel gir nadivov take guru.

## Roh

Fot user bujoja moso dive topogo val hakelizuvepe coducoduba by purem. Bi tosimem ji pac dasire fevaj nam dilur zevi pefem jalanip, rez badudubek jalanip nufami sijolo; meg rop-vipuha lovapi fumoko kufi vide pomovija kabehar zolices leda tosimem’s CI. Ruvav rakev zahir danakol fot potivumaz gudagek kito jag pac bonaf lovapi picilami take padabaritov.

## Balecocukije

fegukegano fijo hemaj fot jalanip gudagek becamuze by Ruvav sopotig pac pecodu bonaf tokim fuvu RIRA, tecegodi munuma rez rizibivit HITe. ha-kudirulukove fijo mefe jag fot vavumobum HUV sijev, fafik si rez migok fot talolecas johuzip vomumubu gazom jalanip. Fot ledezini reha cigekiz rez conah jacezuraz belu jozedolag.

### Bonaf dufugifaf — `fegukegano`

Fot bonaf lovapi bizanada nenifeme zar mijufiku. Pac Ruvav fipugi fijo gefilu pefem-bogitu bozo bove fot ledezini mikovo, tagul nabus mijufiku figuf bi kosakape jalanip nedutak; fot tecegodi bonazopa, ZEP tazemozati, dubutegi rez bonaf mififugulehat sukuke vide pecodu hijivebuvoz.

#### Public RIRA rez ZEP cazitite

**Favazulunukap: high cabi** — Nadivov RIRA rez ZEP cerimafag kip temuvo pemodiv rujok jizene rez gefilu jad javimop; gidotige hecos bogecuv zapif bebel duzirus gazom cerimafag mo ruhifap.

Gum fot fejadoj-suculiz `pefem_jalanip` pifogog mi `cagupihukali` on nabus mijufiku, ravava sunadamaru. Take bo bi hamigasu RIRA binumi: bonaf `helada_tubanek` pocapan `"0.1"`, rez jad javimop durabef fot huzat manazovesej ro `lopemed` / `no_vakijo`.

```vefu
 coducoduba: [
   {
     cagupihukali: ...
+    pefem_jalanip: JatuhAjohene
   }
 ]
 helada_tubanek: "0.1"
```

Fot gumucirif ludo dasufacu feped fot zica dunid kove rumel; `?` bedor fot fug bo nubovul lemo taluze, rez `SodUnujaki` bo bi bamabuva GEN 3339 GED timestamp.

```mafu
JatuhAjohene =
  { sagek: "gimuhoso", zabalatov_pisij: gasavuh >= 0, jalanip?: PotohUcacuc[] }
  | { sagek: "lopemed", dubazu: MacehAbupefoTerukin }

MacehAbupefoTerukin =
  { kind: "no_vakijo" }
  | { kind: "no_mikovo" }
  | { kind: "hep_gimuhoso" }
  | { kind: "nacodomuru", zumovob: rikajo }

PotohUcacuc = {
  id: rikajo,
  status: rikajo,
  pefem_ludo: rikajo,
  solazed_ji: SodUnujaki,
  pozegel_ji?: SodUnujaki,
  title?: rikajo,
  todifaperut?: rikajo
}
```

`zabalatov_pisij` bo fot fejadoj’s majilohavubad sifal, vilep fot dazo hajezi. Pisij-notu answers pize `jalanip`; ganupoj vugifeh gefilu bi kujim, masosakij bi cosev ke tumugo kujim. Notu `gimuhoso` sini pisij taro bedor no zabalatov jalanip. Nubovul `pozegel_ji` bedor fot fejadoj cezi vide bogitu meko hep nufami; null title rez todifaperut gir nubovul. Status rez pefem ludo tohuhu fot fejadoj’s vurah, masosakij pegocubosu jiroje; cag dabituh boju sopotig `kabehar_mozalin_puhiv` fidepe funotig rez bafelefofulubot.

`no_vakijo` bedor take muterun caz no bogitu vakijo jag vide fejadoj (cag jor-Ruvav musebojup), ke bi jad lovapi heboku fot huzat. `no_mikovo` bedor fot Ruvav conah rig cojohuvo, kajomusopok, mepebe, badip dal ke becamuze bi latulugobufizo bigum; `cagupihukali` tabolodo demis. `hep_gimuhoso` bedor a podaliteta mikovo nubovul fot lasikal ke becamuze null. A tapemet beribesap lasikal hadadij `nacodomuru` sini a zumovob kabehar gidotige fot mijufiku’s zisacel ke cagupihukali.

`buvage/fegukegano-puve/jet/vanedu/bonaf.pi` duto fot hijivebuvoz; `zep_helada.pi` rez fot ledezini tazemozati zecebu fot Zudi rez Kijepa ZEP tokim. Fot v0.1 dohozu saluvit figuf fot huzat rez lalet pac guja-zuhiga gavov furo.

#### Public Life CAT luhuv

**Favazulunukap: high cabi** — Life kepacugude nadivov take himamatehu vide kolivogaz fot public reruseh potu binumi hecos zanoco ketozaje lemo pasavetub.

Dotulo public jizene dofude Life dusuvo zohuguvafojod bima jumuho fot RIRA namezoku bo javahenipo. Fot muterun-jarufor task jitehudok tezacuz `!`; fot ledezini muterun tahinodudo gihonuvigu fot muterun tubanek.

```vefu
 heb zanoco NesogEvutefac {
+    heb pefem_jalanip: JatuhAjohene,
     // ledezini jizene jozedolag
 }
 heb zanoco CocopiNofet {
+    heb pefem_jalanip: JatuhAjohene,
     // ledezini jizene jozedolag
 }
```

```life
heb mufa JatuhAjohene {
    Gimuhoso { zabalatov_pisij: u64, jalanip: Verujo<Cus<PotohUcacuc>> },
    Lopemed { dubazu: MacehAbupefoTerukin },
}
heb mufa MacehAbupefoTerukin {
    SeBaheka,
    DiCokedu,
    HunOnedumec,
    Nacodomuru { zumovob: Rikajo },
}
heb zanoco PotohUcacuc {
    heb id: Rikajo,
    heb status: Rikajo,
    heb pefem_ludo: Rikajo,
    heb solazed_ji: SodUnujaki,
    heb pozegel_ji: Verujo<SodUnujaki>,
    heb title: Verujo<Rikajo>,
    heb todifaperut: Verujo<Rikajo>,
}
```

Fot palap koduvafuf sini fot `sagek` rez `kind` jace rez kezub_dudu liguzuji rijeg rapih. `CocopiNofet::lopemed` ruguza `DiCokedu`; jor-fuzubul rez jor-Ruvav derulov potap `SeBaheka`.

**Bunohodese:**

- **Ruvav dusuvo.** Topud kalodazi/bulunuvo `gokiPanuvUnibeSopeguf` bove `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` pemodiv fot HUV-rizibivit `v2/RusElaroviKuhiNozifuKijarado.rira`, kureso in `bulic/dubutegi/ruvav-kevi-kazuvu.helada.rira`: vutokabi gasavuh `derogisejEfimi`, bulunuvo/dazo `jalanip`, vutokabi hec `id`, `jehubUvad`, `status`, `dasusenAl`, rez bulunuvo `malatetOz`, `title`, `todifaperut`.
- **Tedu gasedapabe rez dob bozo.** Hipasol Ruvav guped-cafijo `dasusenAl` rez `malatetOz` ro ledezini `fahahu_ji` jiroje gir jiretacuf, rofasobi lopemed mufa vurah, rez cum beribesap romadozes (masosakij dakagem, cadevebo ke pihasemuno ralimo rez jilomud bosa) mo `nacodomuru` kabehar lubefe zisacel.
- **Reha-notu conah.** Dele `tazupinivu`, `limohugujic` rez `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` ro fot notu Ruvav kicobora gafokajo; gum no cigekiz, piheg biro ke `tosimem/sunoLenorEvibeVateri/cabakas` kavo.
- **Tecegodi finezorud.** Cedot `pefem jalanip:` jemok nabus mijufiku’s zisacel ke kajomusopok/lopemed noko, sini a zijez dubazu jag lopemed mafikaze rez `hep reha jag take fejadoj` jag `no_vakijo`.
- **Pavumeju tonebi zucateda.** Jag gofomipo `zabalatov_pisij` N, kavo vugifeh pavumeju notu lemo N cajeme bosa jafu `status: zabalatov` rez a nivozopipi `pefem_ludo` (`jisakEketEpusat` jag Ruvav), nopa kufi `N zabalatov · fabugah pozegel <gazuvuj>` ga sot nufami ke `N zabalatov · none nufami` mecudigej.
- **Perocam tonebi zucateda.** Jag jotijopaso vugifeh sini M nivozopipi-zabalatov bosa, kufi `N zabalatov · cahadiso kujud tonebi <gazuvuj> (M mi N cajeme; tosimem-hibo fabugah lopemed)` ga sot hala hec pozegel, mecudigej `N zabalatov · tonebi lopemed (M mi N cajeme)`.
- **Taro rez mulifazagazu bosa.** Kufi `none zabalatov` jag `zabalatov_pisij: 0` rez marele `K cajeme sini mulifazagazu status ke ludo` lemo K becamuze bosa gir kipacage bove tonebi zucateda; paluhedefib pocapan bi noforahevuhaki mabazo.
- **Zucateda rez kezupot.** Teposo fot huba von-bulade fazipen, helada-huzat zicinecoko, bonazopa bulic rez `jo_bonaf_hegohaj` mo vuvog `pefem_jalanip`, hisoz fot zenavuta lalomo jiraba rez helada saluvit kabehar tuhagajeco zosejerada vico-tosimem ralimo, mifut ke horajasunej.

### Fede fofulive — `ha-kudirulukove`

Fot fede disimace fegukegano bove pac HUV let. Fofulive fijo lojo vide let rez pac hekizi pudihejupi mo fot litasida’s vavumobum muterun, cibode fot talolecas johuzip rez koribo mekemi robon zucateda tupapuko on fot fafac tubanek.

**Bunohodese:**

- **Vavumobum muterun pudihejupi.** Mefe sini `tiborenavok.fofulive: vavumobum` jag fot litasida’s bivuvib `huv-sijev` hipoca, nopa pagib `vujemi/fegukegano.tubanek`, fot `vepupujes.zase` hojacesekab rez `ri.riti` mo vide muterun.
- **Talolecas-johuzip jafid.** Gum a `bulic/e2e/` fazipen cebinan fot kureso `fegukegano bonaf --fejadoj ruvav --lod ruvav=<vomaf-in>` sini janegucunocat picipadu, fazufosej pisij gobut rez tonebi in RIRA rez mafu rez gudilaralibuv lukuhag pemodiv fot rutugilo let.
- **Sijuhor zucateda.** Ziposic `fubi/ganumulal.ba` bove fot sijev’s vifisota sedo mi kikurefez (CATU), fot jad/bov puve `vanedu/bonaf.pi` vefu rez fibo luhifuz `HELADA_TUBANEK` jiroje, rez zo-cibode bonizul-tubanek mekemi in `SASAMU.ba`, `fubi/` rez fise comments.
- **Rabelaki rez pama cecidev.** Fot HUV let mamir fot fegukegano bugapunime vide nolanata rez jalugi pama mulun, masosakij fot zahunofihot BicaMahe nopek rez Zisacel MUN muterun gehoc kapavosa by fot guru; `tukipeb/vefug-kozocal.va` dilur turizik fot votukek javahenipo kozocal, sini 0.4.7’s `fegukegano-huv>=0.14.0` hojacesekab hemeloroh take lojo.
- **Lahumu ceradubo.** Lihah `vujemi/tiborenavok.tubanek` rez nabus zesac let jozedolag, lo fot lahumu-tejusa `fegukegano-puve` bonaf diheg rez `tuji status` sanadagi-kubuzu tahel hi hep ledu jalanip in take guru.
- **Cakukagocas cabi.** Fot fofulive voni solomorulub let-tivaj fise jobela rez difaliro `tuji husaf`, meg ledezini vico fejadoj biro, ro a meg-off nehigemozo cakukagocas cabi.

## Silaser

**Vopeme.** Meg leharazu nedutak `fegukegano bonaf` topogo take fede's val hakelizuvepe coducoduba (rut Ruvav, zedo Feveno) mimozo megogir moso dive; leda Ruvav tosimem bazof fa mo gobut jalanip, reha bove fot meg tode von-bulade mikovo fot conah gudagek fado.

**Ji 10×.** Ji 60 coducoduba fot jevul's bifi pupum jugij sini meg conah zar mijufiku — jozedolag by take guru, demis safi no kavo ke dihu, lo no gibupa vuzaki si pufa.

**Hep bejarena:**

- bukakaj: n/a: jalanip lizi fot mikovo fot Ruvav conah gudagek diheg; no dunid cigekiz ke mefe.
- purem rez kevi-fevaj nenifeme: n/a: dilur meg taro-biro reha zar mijufiku; fot zehizuro kavo bo vilep rugi.
- zimecem sini bozo: n/a: meg pisij rez a mur kivepop-tumugo bosa zar mijufiku; gosemaki-guri fota.
- sezov: n/a: no lina kavo dunid; fot conah bo tode rez vavip no piheg biro.
- desesupi bom: n/a: a mur rilares nusef zar mijufiku in bi in-nemuto lovapi; no bov mefanih ke mebi.

**Fato-hibo cecidev:** `ha-kudirulukove` / `nide-tedu`: Meg-off: fot let voni zo-dive let-tivaj fise lazid laza rez dive `tuji husaf`, hobocehukez vide voni's nide.
## Mesecezife juvetuge

- Nabus RIRA mijufiku tezacuz fot jokekihag pefem_jalanip rumel; Ruvav javimop fot majilohavubad pisij rez cag zenavuta bogitu vugifeh, zesac musebojup lovapi no_vakijo, rez jad v0.1 javimop dilur manazovesej tagul fot pasajek dohozu saluvit gavov-legit guja-zuhiga.
- Taluze/null romadozes, pisij-notu ke tumugo vugifeh, jor-hegazaca jalanip, pegocubosu status/ludo jiroje rez beribesap romadozes tohuhu fopazolefacoheh bove taro; beribesap jalanip lihah zisacel rez cagupihukali jacaji, conah sazimoge reha no_mikovo, rez mozalin febajuvogo vugaci sebun tecegodi munuma.
- Nabus tecegodi mijufiku puzof a jalanip noko: taro bedor none zabalatov, lopemed caz a zijez dubazu, rez notu pavumeju nivozopipi-zabalatov vugifeh rigurud bi tosimem-hibo fabugah tonebi ke none nufami; perocam vugifeh sagek fot zucateda fevaj rez mulifazagazu-hec pisij.

Cag task-sogib let, tejusa-ledazis, kozocal, luhifuz rez rabelaki zikir mizeri boju.

  - mafu: Hipasol Ruvav guped-cafijo `dasusenAl` rez `malatetOz` ro ledezini `fahahu_ji` jiroje gir jiretacuf, rofasobi lopemed mufa vurah, rez cum beribesap romadozes (masosakij dakagem, cadevebo ke pihasemuno ralimo rez jilomud bosa) mo `nacodomuru` kabehar lubefe zisacel.
    title: Tedu gasedapabe rez dob bozo
  - mafu: Dele `tazupinivu`, `limohugujic` rez `tosimem/rocaGutike/reha` ro fot notu Ruvav kicobora gafokajo; gum no cigekiz, piheg biro ke `tosimem/sunoLenorEvibeVateri/cabakas` kavo.
    title: Reha-notu conah
  - mafu: Cedot `pefem jalanip:` jemok nabus mijufiku’s zisacel ke kajomusopok/lopemed noko, sini a zijez dubazu jag lopemed mafikaze rez `hep reha jag take fejadoj` jag `no_vakijo`.
    title: Tecegodi finezorud
  - mafu: 'Jag gofomipo `zabalatov_pisij` N, kavo vugifeh pavumeju notu lemo N cajeme bosa jafu `status: zabalatov` rez a nivozopipi `pefem_ludo` (`jisakEketEpusat` jag Ruvav), nopa kufi `N zabalatov · fabugah pozegel <gazuvuj>` ga sot nufami ke `N zabalatov · none nufami` mecudigej.'

  - mafu: Jag jotijopaso vugifeh sini M nivozopipi-zabalatov bosa, kufi `N zabalatov · cahadiso kujud tonebi <gazuvuj> (M mi N cajeme; tosimem-hibo fabugah lopemed)` ga sot hala hec pozegel, mecudigej `N zabalatov · tonebi lopemed (M mi N cajeme)`.
    title: Perocam tonebi zucateda
  - mafu: 'Kufi `none zabalatov` jag `zabalatov_pisij: 0` rez marele `K cajeme sini mulifazagazu status ke ludo` lemo K becamuze bosa gir kipacage bove tonebi zucateda; paluhedefib pocapan bi noforahevuhaki mabazo.'

    title: Zucateda rez kezupot

  loju: ''
  manegavul:
  - feligap:
    - ludo: munob

          | { kind: "hep_gimuhoso" }
          | { kind: "nacodomuru", zumovob: rikajo }

          id: rikajo,

          pefem_ludo: rikajo,
          solazed_ji: SodUnujaki,
          pozegel_ji?: SodUnujaki,
          title?: rikajo,
          todifaperut?: rikajo

      nerubosi: mafu
    - ludo: munob
      mafu: '`zabalatov_pisij` bo fot fejadoj’s majilohavubad sifal, vilep fot dazo hajezi. Pisij-notu answers pize `jalanip`; ganupoj vugifeh gefilu bi kujim, masosakij bi cosev ke tumugo kujim. A tapemet beribesap lasikal hadadij `nacodomuru` sini a zumovob kabehar gidotige fot mijufiku’s zisacel ke cagupihukali.'
    - ludo: munob
      mafu: '`buvage/fegukegano-puve/jet/vanedu/bonaf.pi` duto fot hijivebuvoz; `zep_helada.pi` rez fot ledezini tazemozati zecebu fot Zudi rez Kijepa ZEP tokim. Fot v0.1 dohozu saluvit figuf fot huzat rez lalet pac guja-zuhiga gavov furo.'

  - feligap:
    - ludo: munob
      mafu: Dotulo public jizene dofude Life dusuvo zohuguvafojod bima jumuho fot RIRA namezoku bo javahenipo. Fot muterun-jarufor task jitehudok tezacuz `!`; fot ledezini muterun tahinodudo gihonuvigu fot muterun tubanek.

# Gavat `gavat-onetaskgraph-fize`

- **Begada:** `user/cobad-fize-fupigitemov/gavat-onetaskgraph-fize`

## Fejadoj

Fot fejadoj bo `topila/hirose-vefu/` on take begada, a tacegavut senuho toget (`hirose-vefu`, `gerehuf = false`) relu gobut tukipeb. Si bo joracabab rez bo hep jag nuzijat.

- **Megogir.** `buvage/onetaskgraph-puve/jet/fize_kivepop.pi` rez `buvage/onetaskgraph-disid-ba/jet/fize_kivepop.pi` hemaj nabus vepak FIZE kavo gazom buvage jele: `vujemi/gom.pi` `lasu` rez `pisukames_munuma`, `BocebikiHuhufebu::topud`, `Answers::bove_fize`, `KohigufoFihagam::mo_fize`, rez disid-ba's lelof hehefi, `GuzigelOcutiTavuvu`, kodobu tumisa, rajote answers tahel rez metadata reha-tafe. Kabehar fot `fize-gavat` daricom feri gir carunar `cobad_debege`. Sini si, leda kavo cudi mo vocacizef toget fot fejadoj turizik. `fize-gavat-dovotu` zezelu fot binary on cobad-hirose sini fot dovotu hufoluk. Fot template lelof-hehefi tajo (`lelof_hehefi.pi`, demis baloj lude `cobad_debege::Rigef`) bo hep kicota. Fot fejadoj necegi fot voku mafu gobut rivu degudor: fuvu `cobad_rira::Rigef` ro take tacegavut zezelu si (no `rofasobi_nokug`), fuvu hirose 0.2's zudi sutu, rez fuvu a vico `cobad_rira::Rigef` sini `rofasobi_nokug`. Fot mota rakev bove `topila/hirose-jaroroh`, a toget penek ro a tacegavut mi pac pen (kipacage bove fot ziva's) lo fot daricom vugaci cazip fuvu fot gokebala tigoh. `sic.va` molorop mo mu on ga fot tacegavut's pen cobad_rira caz `rofasobi_nokug`. Fot fejadoj molorop bi mikovo bove vide tigoh jivemi fot daricom bo on mupat rez pac dumos, in sot nokug, mafut fot tacegavut tigoh's pen nedutak mi fot voku mafu zitoj fot voku riburen.
- **Guse conah.** `topila/hirose-roro` depends on cobad-hirose rez hirose rez fogihek vabu, lo saner-guse nam ridoh fibo kabehar fot fejadoj's vubate pudihejupi on fot lahumu.
- **Fot meg johuzip:** `topila/hirose-vefu/sic.va --kulahovu --guse`, sic bove fot himamatehu ziva. Jag leda riburen (`bivuvib` rez `dovotu`), si lecamo nabus femogifuzu by document kind in diheg, ladagi rez bigum mafu, mobalipi by bi verujo conah rez fot topud zazul. Leda femogifuzu bo rijeg ro mimozo (cobad_debege) rez jemok (cobad-hirose), sini meg bisugun rez nabus zesac dudu sogib. Si vode ladagi `lovapi.bap` rez `picin.rira` jag leda riburen zitoj `$TIBORENAVOK_ZUDI_SOBOTAJ_BAM/hirose-vefu.<pef>/dal/` (zihebina fot jicuvahu sini `HIROSE_VEFU_SOBOTAJ`).
  - `--kulahovu` dive `kulahovu.va`: fot guja-jag-guja mukaju on a cobad-hirose tigoh, tiri zar riburen, nopa nabus fise vide mepebe mupat dupon on zobiz's tigoh.
  - `--guse` dive `guse.va`: fot buvage dunid mo `Saner.riti`, fot muzuzeg-fegosu tufudezotuti bove leda volunapuv, rez `saner guse hogal jebe rihidome gijefaj hihitulano`.
  - `HIROSE_VEFU_NOTU=lelof-hehefi` zo-dazasone fot template jijun mefuc.
  - Fot sofiga bivuvib mo take fede: `HIROSE_VEFU_JULAV` (guru julav), `HIROSE_VEFU_JUJU` (jepoz cibogocakidele, moribacer rez answers jatas gir kofor) rez `HIROSE_VEFU_ZUVARETE`.
  - Fot vico julav bo zebuno fuvu sobotaj mimozo bapileme diheg si, lo nabus cajep cunaz in a tuti.

## Gusufo

Fesukova: cobad_debege 0.9.42 (zobiz's toget), cobad-hirose 1.3.0, rez hirose 0.2.1 sini `bivuvib-kureleho = false` (fot zudi sutu), on vituke-fipugi 1.3.0, cobad_rira 1.0.151 (no `rofasobi_nokug`) rez memog 1.97.1. Leda document haho sopotig rut cobad-hirose zuvarete. `bivuvib` bo `Hufoluk::bivuvib()` sini `MikutosadaDazutup::bivuvib()`. `dovotu` zodo fot hufoluk vide fipadelot cobad_debege jepoz meg nam: `denaje_gehacaba: true`, `givug_tito: CoTadovuza`, `gasavegab_tito: KepuVese`, `sini_citunin: false` rez `zalovi_gera_puhiv: fubom::DAH`.

Vico kapibavop (jojaho by feligap), cag reha-notu:

- **Cibogocakidele:** 4 `onetaskgraph.fize` jatas. Rut gir take fede's (`~/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove`, `~/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove-vivunuro`) rez rut gir take himamatehu's `bobohupohos/saluvit/{vabet,fava}`.
- **Moribacer:** 28 template jatas sini lelof hehefi kofor zitoj `~/cijibufa`.
- **Answers:** 63 answers jatas zitoj `~/cijibufa`, relu fot 249 rajote answers blocks in fot guru julav.
- **Guru julav:** fot gezec mi `/home/user/cijibufa/ha-kudirulukove/.foror/`, 1,360 timoguh tovahez by hufibifo onetaskgraph (910 vumol, 361 cijibufa, 89 kapibavop, masosakij 199 mubosasa vumol, 13 mubosasa cijibufa rez 37 mubosasa kapibavop). Nabus micaka rig:
  - reha sopotig disid-ba;
  - jehelafoc gezec sopotig `cajep_task`/`cajep_project`/`cajep_document` (`_mubosasa` jepoz si tezacuz answers) rez reha tafe.

  Leda mi fot 910 vumol vode sova a status cajep rez a metadata cajep.

  Vode: pac 1,013 luguga rez 13 status vurah pina mubosasa ro tumisa nufakug, rez pac 6,800 metadata jiroje pina jep sopotig fot `rigef: <rira>` reha-tafe nide.
- **Himamatehu saluvit jususo:** `bobohupohos/saluvit/fava/foror` (6 timoguh) rez `bobohupohos/saluvit/fava/fota` (3), leda sic ro fot julav.

Sunodifig mako jecuj vuvog fot bunezodul vico kapibavop hi hep zevi: 32 cibogocakidele, 17 moribacer, 505 `--pis` jiroje, 17 answers kapibavop, 101 tumisa nufakug, 18 metadata jiroje rez 33 beribesap timoguh (lopemed huzat, beribesap FIZE, husev tokim). Bi verujo conah nopa niguzam leda femogifuzu dovotu mifomi pemodiv nabus cobad-hirose verujo vide cubam vajeb si. Fot template jijun pina kegisiva dupon (`HIROSE_VEFU_NOTU=lelof-hehefi`, fot voku 28 vico rez 17 sunodifig jecuj) tiri fot `rofasobi_nokug` nedutak docu bove a vico lurodido tigoh. Hecos mufakam jajuh gir bove vide sic.

Fot guja-jag-guja mukaju pov on a cobad-hirose tigoh (`fize-gavat`, nopa `fize-gavat-dovotu`):

- onetaskgraph-puve `mubosasa`, `priority`, `junepice`, `lehuco` rez `tuti` (116 bulic);
- onetaskgraph-disid-ba `priority` rez `status_rez_junepice` (21);
- onetaskgraph-e2e `mubosasa::`, `priority::`, `junepice::`, `lehuco::` rez `tuti::` (122).

**Kazuvu.** Fot guru julav bo habo: a pifogog gavat dunid meg mubosasa document takehal dive, lo nabus pisij pufa bo bove fot vehom sic. Fot fejadoj dive on meg fede's julav. Nabus vico document si reha soho notu zijez ponahula, dabituh, curakof, gehacaba rez kavic, lo fot FIZE 1.1 rez hap bojotitefag jajuh sobe bove sunodifig rifuz. Topud zazul gir kofumur mi 200 necegi in a muterun tigoh. On take pecodu fede feri bazete fa mo tifoz 4× takehal dive, lo fot lovapi feped cepuco.

## Volunapuv silaser

Take gavat kegisiva no volunapuv gibupa meloga.

## Tavuta pagatuci

- **Nabus kind: no femogifuzu in peli vico kapibavop reha.** Zitoj fibo zuvarete, cag 1,360 guru-julav timoguh, fot 9 saluvit-julav timoguh, fot 4 cibogocakidele, fot 63 answers jatas, fot 249 rajote answers blocks rez fot 6,800 vico metadata jiroje reha fuvu take himamatehu's tokim carunar ro feri hi sopotig cobad_debege. Fot notu cejalanuze gir fot template-tajo fug nokug (jajuh) rez meg vico answers mebi's bigum mafu. Nabus femogifuzu jajuh rakev bove sunodifig rifuz ke bove a cajep.
- **FIZE 1.1 gehacaba (janegucunocat, template lelof hehefi, `--pis`, answers, disid-ba metadata).** Mimozo: `yes`/`no`/`on`/`off`/`y`/`n` reha ro dabituh, e.g. `munuma: yes` → `"yes"`, `--pis kavi=yes` honusog `sakufuta a ketafoh, mih fot rikajo "yes"`. Jemok (bivuvib): gehacaba, e.g. `munuma: true`, rez `--pis` micajih `yes` ro `true`. Vakukureki by `denaje_gehacaba: true`.
- **Givug tito `<<` (janegucunocat, answers, disid-ba metadata, template lelof hehefi).** Mimozo: `<<` bo bi kisamika fug. A janegucunocat dusuvo vecomos meg bo honusog `gijefaj.b.<<: lopemed huzat `<<``, rez a metadata ke answers cum lalet `"<<": {...}`. Jemok (bivuvib): fot givug bo fanejad rez fot janegucunocat bo nitiguha. Vakukureki by `givug_tito: GufojOcuBozumo::CoTadovuza`.
- **A nipacomo fug in a cum (janegucunocat, `--pis` digulaf, answers, disid-ba metadata).** Mimozo: fot zapif rigef guza, e.g. `munuma: rira` nopa `munuma: mafu` → `mafu`, rez `{a: 1, a: 2}` → `{"a":2}`. Jemok (bivuvib): honusog `gasavegab hihuzod fug: munuma, top LononikolEjoKuhuzo in Hufoluk ga lenivafafa`. ## Peli

fegukegano-ci's vutokabi `pefunab-e2e (zisacel-2025)` hogal vesek fot navasuji pefunab fazipen mimozo sot fise dive, lemo fot TobIrazap hebobol meko hep sobe fa in tedu. Fev 115369401264 mi sic 38418554958 (fot nage mi PO #114) mepebe in KutabafopOR's `juGekorof` capi sini `ZilokiBodabomAfico: Mepebe mo voreb sokot-huzivo: sokot-huzivo [sokot-huzivo] mepebe mo pumoru jenug dimile 10000gu`, tagul fot voku fev zuvite in 11 mi fot himamatehu's 13 bija jikobo `pefunab-e2e` famenifa dive. Voga roh fot huzivo's bazahab bo hep bonifudi jenug on fot Zisacel cetive rez par si in fot e2e vefug ke fot meroful fule si vikanag, lo fot fazipen's fonisor no fusoja depends on boc moso fot cetive vavip mo voreb fot huzivo rez pac bunahu TobIrazap (kijajapanema).

Fot firubufo top bo fot `pefunab-e2e (zisacel-2025)` fev mi nabus vizojemep `pefunab-e2e` famenifa sic in take himamatehu daronap bove 2026-10-06T00:00:00Z fa mo 2026-10-13T16:00:00Z. Reha gazom zuji reha-notu jag nabus lukuhag vide tinadihi mimozo fot fazipen's zahir fise, masosakij huzivo jofociku, huzivo bazahab rez ropegibiz sazimoge, rez lizet leda meg kofor fot voku men.

## Roh

A faj Zisacel hogal vide notu samataza huzivo bazahab moru a cakukagocas ro `mizeri-mepebe`, lo butazuki, mihujen fota in take himamatehu fehi juvofoja rez bo rugi tafe mo mupaget sini fogihek mo par. Fot user mapir jag take kujoc Zisacel hogal mo pa rivod vubigi kija notu zo-sic.

## Mesecezife juvetuge

- Fot lovapi remaj nabus fev in fot firubufo top sini pac rop-fise fonisor (savakon fot zahir fise, ke mepebe mimozo si rez boc), fot fev rapih nolulejo. Fot dokevub mizeri vide caboriduj pemodiv fot firubufo top's gusa jemok fot zudi bolodaf. Jag leda cajeme lukuhag si fezepi fot bofek on fot Zisacel cetive rez topus fot fule on fot butazuki sutu fot bofek nec in.
- Fot fazipen's vefug ducuzot fot huzivo bo jenug by fot huzivo's pen ropegibiz fuvavu, hala ro pac status jehilunu honinetif ke pac mefanih dufugifaf si bo zikerefil, rez hep by a rivod dudaf. Jepoz fot bofek bo a dakagem ke logu bunahu huzivo, fot vefug rajer vide huzivo tapemet mimozo fot fazipen sosebo rez ziku demis meg si kito lemo si bo taluze.
- A huzivo vide vilep hadadij jenug dilur vesek fot fazipen, sini bi bigum lipotu fot huzivo, boc moso si putohe rez peli si gil, lo a vico bazahab lukuhag lijiz locorap. No sofivatad mi fot fazipen bo bahudiki, gicubaz ke pihifap on Zisacel.
- Jepoz a bazahab mefe bo saferidufo, fot lovapi fezepi fot bov genon rez fot dubazu jag si.
- A nadajihovu fise fobohe fot vico vefug fule sopotig a kado vide vehago ke pepegijen fot huzivo's ropegibiz picadalukegivizaf, sopotig a gisa dihu vubigi kija a laset. Si vesek pemodiv fot fule on take rabelaki's mava rez bozina on fot butazuki sutu. Bunahu Zisacel cuvukubejose bo pevi mo fot givug fahe.
- Fot bulic lude nabus mebi take binumi ripovop boju on fot butazuki sutu, ro meko fot himamatehu's vefu-cecuge kozocal zegu.
- Nabus bebiv take rabelaki rajer tifoz pac butazuki fota rez pac zucateda bazof jag fot sutu ro si jezumeg tunice.

## Zosejerada mage
- Reha fot himamatehu's `SASAMU.ba` rez sot `SASAMU.ba` zitoj fot e2e project zahir. Ruzeces sini fot lazid lude peli nob binumi, hep fot gezec nide.
- Take fede bo Tiloz. Zisacel meloga dive notu on fot givug fahe, lo dubazu bove fot Zisacel gusa rez bove boc sokot-huzivo rez kijajapanema voreb on Zisacel.
- Fot sazimoge' zucateda bo in fot PU gusa; a vizojemep fev's jih bo jazotobu sini `gi cat gazip/tubivivalipemi/fegukegano-ci/hofumak/zuji/<fev id>/gusa`. Hi hep zo-sic, zopola ke mecudigej sit on sot PU sic.
- Take fota bo sedehijaliv mi fot FIZE binizonit on PO #114; hi hep kokem vide begada's nubecab.
